        }
        .result-modal .btn-close-modal.danger {
            background: #ef4444;
        }
        .result-modal .btn-close-modal.danger:hover {
            background: #dc2626;
        }
        .result-modal .detail-box {
            background: #0d1524;
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 12px 16px;
            margin: 12px 0;
            border: 1px solid #1a2234;
        }
        .result-modal .detail-box .label {
            color: #64748b;
            font-size: 12px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }
        .result-modal .detail-box .value {
            font-weight: 600;
            font-size: 16px;
            color: #ffffff;
        }
        
        .bottom-nav {
            background: #111827 !important;
            border-top: 1px solid #1e293b;
            padding: 4px 0 env(safe-area-inset-bottom);
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 0;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            z-index: 1050;
        }
        .bottom-nav .nav-link {
            color: #64748b !important;
            text-align: center;
            padding: 4px 8px;
            font-size: 10px;
            font-weight: 500;
            min-width: 48px;
            text-decoration: none;
        }
        .bottom-nav .nav-link i {
            font-size: 20px;
            display: block;
            margin-bottom: 1px;
        }
        .bottom-nav .nav-link.active {
            color: #8B5CF6 !important;
        }
        .bottom-nav .nav-link.active i {
            color: #8B5CF6 !important;
        }
        
        @media (max-width: 480px) {
            .task-card .task-title { font-size: 12px; }
            .task-card .icon { width: 40px; height: 40px; font-size: 16px; }
            .stats-mini .number { font-size: 16px; }
            .filter-btn { font-size: 11px; padding: 4px 12px; }
            .timer-overlay .big-timer { font-size: 48px; }
            .result-modal .icon-big { font-size: 52px; }
            .result-modal .reward-amount { font-size: 28px; }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <!-- ============================================
    ✅ TOP NAVIGATION
    ============================================ -->
    
    <iframe 
        src="/includes/nav.html" 
        style="width:100%; height:56px; border:none; position:fixed; top:0; left:0; z-index:1000; background:transparent !important; overflow:visible;"
        scrolling="no"
        id="navIframe"
        allowtransparency="true">
    </iframe>

    <script>
        window.addEventListener('message', function(event) {
            var iframe = document.getElementById('navIframe');
            if (!iframe) return;
            
            if (event.data && event.data.type === 'expandNav') {
                iframe.style.height = '400px';
                iframe.style.background = 'transparent';
            } else if (event.data && event.data.type === 'collapseNav') {
                iframe.style.height = '56px';
                iframe.style.background = 'transparent';
            }
        });
    </script>

    <!-- ============================================
    MAIN CONTENT
    ============================================ -->
    
    <div class="container mt-5 pt-4 pb-5">
        
        <!-- Stats -->
        <div class="row g-2 g-md-3 mb-4">
            <div class="col-6">
                <div class="stats-mini">
                    <div class="number" id="todayEarnings">₹0</div>
                    <div class="label">Today's Earnings</div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="col-6">
                <div class="stats-mini">
                    <div class="number" id="todayTasks">0/10</div>
                    <div class="label">Tasks Today</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Filters -->
        <div class="d-flex flex-wrap gap-2 mb-4">
            <button class="filter-btn active" data-filter="all" onclick="filterTasks('all')">All</button>
            <button class="filter-btn" data-filter="website" onclick="filterTasks('website')">Website</button>
            <button class="filter-btn" data-filter="youtube" onclick="filterTasks('youtube')">YouTube</button>
            <button class="filter-btn" data-filter="instagram" onclick="filterTasks('instagram')">Instagram</button>
            <button class="filter-btn" data-filter="whatsapp" onclick="filterTasks('whatsapp')">WhatsApp</button>
            <button class="filter-btn" data-filter="telegram" onclick="filterTasks('telegram')">Telegram</button>
        </div>

        <!-- Tasks List -->
        <h5 class="text-white mb-3"><i class="fas fa-list me-2"></i>Available Tasks</h5>
        <div id="tasksContainer" class="row g-3">
            <div class="col-12 text-center text-secondary py-5">
                <div class="spinner-border text-primary"></div>
                <p class="mt-2">Loading tasks...</p>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ============================================
    TIMER OVERLAY
    ============================================ -->
    
    <div class="timer-overlay" id="timerOverlay">
        <div class="big-timer" id="bigTimerDisplay">30</div>
        <div class="timer-label">⏳ Task in progress...</div>
        <div class="timer-progress-big">
            <div class="bar" id="bigTimerProgress" style="width: 100%"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="warning-text">
            ⚠️ <strong>Please stay on the task page!</strong><br>
            If you come back before the timer ends, the task will fail.
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ============================================
    MODALS
    ============================================ -->
    
    <!-- Task Modal -->
    <div class="modal fade" id="taskModal" tabindex="-1">
        <div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered">
            <div class="modal-content bg-dark text-white border-secondary">
                <div class="modal-header">
                    <h5 class="modal-title" id="taskModalTitle">Complete Task</h5>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-close btn-close-white" data-bs-dismiss="modal"></button>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-body" id="taskModalBody">
                    <!-- Dynamic content -->
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ============================================
    RESULT MODAL - UPDATED (No Toasts)
    ============================================ -->
    
    <div class="modal fade result-modal" id="resultModal" tabindex="-1" data-bs-backdrop="static" data-bs-keyboard="false">
        <div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered">
            <div class="modal-content">
                <div class="modal-body text-center" id="resultModalBody">
                    <!-- Dynamic content -->
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ============================================
    BOTTOM NAVIGATION
    ============================================ -->
    
    <nav class="bottom-nav">
        <div class="container d-flex justify-content-around">
            <a href="dashboard.html" class="nav-link" data-page="home">
                <i class="fas fa-home"></i>
                <span>Home</span>
            </a>
            <a href="earn.html" class="nav-link active" data-page="earn">
                <i class="fas fa-tasks"></i>
                <span>Earn</span>
            </a>
            <a href="leaderboard.html" class="nav-link" data-page="leaderboard">
                <i class="fas fa-trophy"></i>
                <span>Rank</span>
            </a>
            <a href="invite.html" class="nav-link" data-page="invite">
                <i class="fas fa-user-plus"></i>
                <span>Invite</span>
            </a>
            <a href="withdraw.html" class="nav-link" data-page="withdraw">
                <i class="fas fa-money-bill-wave"></i>
                <span>Withdraw</span>
            </a>
        </div>
    </nav>

    <!-- Toast Container (Only for non-task messages) -->
    <div class="toast-container position-fixed top-0 end-0 p-3"></div>

    <!-- Bootstrap JS -->
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>

    <script>
        // ============================================
        // ✅ AUTH CHECK
        // ============================================
        
        const token = localStorage.getItem('auth_token');
        const userData = localStorage.getItem('user_data');
        
        if (!token || !userData) {
            window.location.replace('/login.html');
        }
        
        console.log('✅ User authenticated, loading earn page');
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ STATE
        // ============================================
        
        let allTasks = [];
        let currentFilter = 'all';
        let timerInterval = null;
        let timerSeconds = 0;
        let isTaskInProgress = false;
        let currentTaskId = null;
        let isTaskCompleted = false;
        let dailyLimit = 10;
        const processingTasks = new Set();
        let resultModal = null;
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ DOM REFS
        // ============================================
        
        const timerOverlay = document.getElementById('timerOverlay');
        const bigTimerDisplay = document.getElementById('bigTimerDisplay');
        const bigTimerProgress = document.getElementById('bigTimerProgress');
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ PAGE VISIBILITY API
        // ============================================
        
        document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function() {
            if (document.hidden) {
                console.log('⚠️ User left the page');
            } else {
                if (isTaskInProgress && !isTaskCompleted) {
                    console.log('⚠️ User returned early - task will fail');
                    clearInterval(timerInterval);
                    isTaskInProgress = false;
                    timerOverlay.classList.remove('show');
                    showResultModal(false, 'Task Failed', '❌ You returned to PaisaPay before the timer ended! Stay on the task page until the timer finishes.');
                }
            }
        });
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ BEFORE UNLOAD
        // ============================================
        
        window.addEventListener('beforeunload', function(e) {
            if (isTaskInProgress && !isTaskCompleted) {
                sessionStorage.setItem('task_interrupted', 'true');
                sessionStorage.setItem('interrupted_task_id', currentTaskId);
                sessionStorage.setItem('interrupted_time', Date.now());
            }
        });
        
        // Check interrupted task
        (function checkInterruptedTask() {
            if (sessionStorage.getItem('task_interrupted') === 'true') {
                const taskId = sessionStorage.getItem('interrupted_task_id');
                console.log('⚠️ Task was interrupted:', taskId);
                sessionStorage.removeItem('task_interrupted');
                sessionStorage.removeItem('interrupted_task_id');
                sessionStorage.removeItem('interrupted_time');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    showResultModal(false, 'Task Failed!', '❌ You left the page during the task. Please try again.');
                }, 500);
            }
        })();
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ LOAD DATA
        // ============================================
        
        async function loadTasks() {
            try {
                const response = await fetch('https://paisa-pay.online/api/tasks/list.php', {
                    headers: {
                        'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token
                    }
                });
                
                if (response.status === 401) {
                    localStorage.removeItem('auth_token');
                    localStorage.removeItem('user_data');
                    window.location.replace('/login.html');
                    return;
                }
                
                const data = await response.json();
                
                if (data.success) {
                    allTasks = data.data || [];
                    
                    if (data.today_stats) {
                        const todayTasks = document.getElementById('todayTasks');
                        if (todayTasks) {
                            const completed = data.today_stats.tasks_completed || 0;
                            todayTasks.textContent = completed + '/' + dailyLimit;
                        }
                        
                        const todayEarnings = document.getElementById('todayEarnings');
                        if (todayEarnings) {
                            todayEarnings.textContent = '₹' + Math.round(data.today_stats.earnings || 0);
                        }
                    }
                    
                    renderTasks(allTasks);
                } else {
                    showToast(data.message || 'Error loading tasks', 'error');
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Load tasks error:', error);
                showToast('Error loading tasks', 'error');
            }
        }
        
        async function loadStats() {
            try {
                const response = await fetch('https://paisa-pay.online/api/user/dashboard.php', {
                    headers: {
                        'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token
                    }
                });
                
                const data = await response.json();
                
                if (data.success) {
                    const d = data.data;
                    const wallet = d.user?.wallet_balance || 0;
                    document.getElementById('walletBalance').textContent = '₹' + Math.round(wallet);
                    
                    const todayEarnings = d.stats?.tasks?.today_earnings || 0;
                    document.getElementById('todayEarnings').textContent = '₹' + Math.round(todayEarnings);
                    
                    const todayTasks = d.stats?.tasks?.today || 0;
                    document.getElementById('todayTasks').textContent = todayTasks + '/' + dailyLimit;
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Load stats error:', error);
            }
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ RENDER TASKS
        // ============================================
        
        function renderTasks(tasks) {
            const container = document.getElementById('tasksContainer');
            
            const filteredTasks = currentFilter === 'all' 
                ? tasks 
                : tasks.filter(t => t.task_type === currentFilter);
            
            if (!filteredTasks || filteredTasks.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="col-12">
                        <div class="card bg-dark text-white text-center py-5 border-secondary">
                            <i class="fas fa-inbox fa-3x text-secondary mb-3"></i>
                            <p class="text-secondary">No tasks available</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
                return;
            }
            
            container.innerHTML = filteredTasks.map(task => {
                const limit = task.daily_limit || 1;
                const completedToday = task.completed_today || 0;
                const remaining = Math.max(0, limit - completedToday);
                const isCompleted = remaining <= 0;
                const disabledClass = isCompleted ? 'disabled' : '';
                
                let progressText = `${completedToday}/${limit} today`;
                if (isCompleted) {
                    progressText = `✅ ${completedToday}/${limit} - Done!`;
                } else if (remaining === 1) {
                    progressText = `${completedToday}/${limit} - ${remaining} left!`;
                } else {
                    progressText = `${completedToday}/${limit} - ${remaining} left`;
                }
                
                return `
                    <div class="col-6 col-md-4 col-lg-3">
                        <div class="task-card ${disabledClass}" data-task-id="${task.id}" onclick="${isCompleted ? '' : `openTask(${task.id})`}">
                            ${isCompleted ? '<div class="disabled-overlay"><i class="fas fa-check-circle me-2"></i>Done</div>' : ''}
                            ${isCompleted ? '<span class="completed-badge">✅ Done</span>' : ''}
                            <div class="icon bg-primary-gradient">
                                <i class="fas ${task.icon || 'fa-link'}"></i>
                            </div>
                            <div class="task-title">${task.title}</div>
                            <div class="task-reward">₹${task.reward_amount}</div>
                            <div class="task-timer"><i class="far fa-clock me-1"></i>${task.timer_seconds || 30}s</div>
                            <small class="text-secondary">${task.task_type}</small>
                            <div class="daily-limit-text">${progressText}</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }).join('');
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ FILTER TASKS
        // ============================================
        
        window.filterTasks = function(filter) {
            currentFilter = filter;
            document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.filter === filter);
            });
            renderTasks(allTasks);
        };
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ OPEN TASK
        // ============================================
        
        window.openTask = function(taskId) {
            if (isTaskInProgress) {
                showToast('⏳ Please wait for current task to complete', 'warning');
                return;
            }
            
            const task = allTasks.find(t => t.id === taskId);
            if (!task) {
                showToast('Task not found', 'error');
                return;
            }
            
            const limit = task.daily_limit || 1;
            const completedToday = task.completed_today || 0;
            const remaining = Math.max(0, limit - completedToday);
            
            if (remaining <= 0) {
                showToast(`✅ Task already completed ${limit}/${limit} times today!`, 'warning');
                return;
            }
            
            const modal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('taskModal'));
            const body = document.getElementById('taskModalBody');
            
            body.innerHTML = `
                <div class="text-center mb-4">
                    <div class="icon bg-primary-gradient mx-auto mb-3" style="width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 12px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 24px; color: white;">
                        <i class="fas ${task.icon || 'fa-link'}"></i>
                    </div>
                    <h5>${task.title}</h5>
                    <p class="text-secondary small">${task.description || 'Complete this task to earn rewards'}</p>
                    <div class="alert alert-warning small mt-2">
                        <i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle me-2"></i>
                        <strong>⚠️ Important!</strong> You will be redirected to the task page. 
                        <strong>Stay there until the timer completes.</strong> 
                        If you come back early, the task will fail!
                    </div>
                </div>
                
                <div class="modal-task-details">
                    <div class="detail-row">
                        <span class="text-secondary">Reward</span>
                        <span class="text-warning fw-bold">₹${task.reward_amount}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="detail-row">
                        <span class="text-secondary">Time Required</span>
                        <span>${task.timer_seconds || 30}s</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="detail-row">
                        <span class="text-secondary">Type</span>
                        <span>${task.task_type}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="detail-row">
                        <span class="text-secondary">Today's Progress</span>
                        <span>${completedToday}/${limit} (${remaining} left)</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
                
                <div class="mt-3">
                    <button class="btn btn-primary w-100" onclick="startTask(${task.id})" id="startTaskBtn">
                        <i class="fas fa-external-link-alt me-2"></i>Go to Task Page
                    </button>
                </div>
            `;
            
            modal.show();
        };
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ START TASK
        // ============================================
        
        window.startTask = function(taskId) {
            if (isTaskInProgress) return;
            
            const task = allTasks.find(t => t.id === taskId);
            if (!task) return;
            
            const limit = task.daily_limit || 1;
            const completedToday = task.completed_today || 0;
            
            if (completedToday >= limit) {
                showToast('✅ Task already completed today', 'warning');
                const modal = bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.getElementById('taskModal'));
                if (modal) modal.hide();
                return;
            }
            
            // Close task modal
            const modal = bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.getElementById('taskModal'));
            if (modal) modal.hide();
            
            // Set task state
            isTaskInProgress = true;
            isTaskCompleted = false;
            currentTaskId = taskId;
            const taskDuration = task.timer_seconds || 30;
            
            // Show timer overlay
            timerOverlay.classList.add('show');
            bigTimerDisplay.textContent = taskDuration;
            bigTimerProgress.style.width = '100%';
            
            // Open URL in new tab
            if (task.url) {
                window.open(task.url, '_blank');
            }
            
            // Start timer
            let remaining = taskDuration;
            
            if (timerInterval) clearInterval(timerInterval);
            
            timerInterval = setInterval(() => {
                remaining--;
                bigTimerDisplay.textContent = remaining;
                bigTimerProgress.style.width = `${(remaining / taskDuration) * 100}%`;
                
                if (!document.hidden) {
                    clearInterval(timerInterval);
                    isTaskInProgress = false;
                    timerOverlay.classList.remove('show');
                    showResultModal(false, 'Task Failed', '❌ You came back to PaisaPay before the timer ended! Stay on the task page until the timer finishes.');
                    return;
                }
                
                if (remaining <= 0) {
                    clearInterval(timerInterval);
                    isTaskCompleted = true;
                    timerOverlay.classList.remove('show');
                    claimTask(taskId);
                }
            }, 1000);
        };
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ SHOW RESULT MODAL - NO TOASTS
        // ============================================
        
        function showResultModal(success, title, message, reward = 0) {
            // Close any existing result modal
            if (resultModal) {
                resultModal.hide();
            }
            
            const modalElement = document.getElementById('resultModal');
            const body = document.getElementById('resultModalBody');
            
            const icon = success ? 'fa-check-circle' : 'fa-times-circle';
            const iconClass = success ? 'success' : 'failed';
            const btnClass = success ? '' : 'danger';
            const btnText = success ? 'Continue' : 'Try Again';
            const titleColor = success ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444';
            
            let rewardHtml = '';
            if (success && reward > 0) {
                rewardHtml = `
                    <div class="detail-box">
                        <div class="label">💰 You Earned</div>
                        <div class="reward-amount">₹${reward}</div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }
            
            body.innerHTML = `
                <div class="icon-big ${iconClass}">
                    <i class="fas ${icon}"></i>
                </div>
                <h3 style="color: ${titleColor};">${title}</h3>
                <div class="message">${message}</div>
                ${rewardHtml}
                <button class="btn-close-modal ${btnClass}" onclick="closeResultModal()">
                    ${btnText}
                </button>
            `;
            
            // Show modal
            resultModal = new bootstrap.Modal(modalElement, {
                backdrop: 'static',
                keyboard: false
            });
            resultModal.show();
        }
        
        function closeResultModal() {
            if (resultModal) {
                resultModal.hide();
                resultModal = null;
            }
            // Refresh data after closing
            loadTasks();
            loadStats();
            resetTaskStates();
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ TASK CLAIM - UPDATED
        // ============================================
        
        async function claimTask(taskId) {
            // Check if task is already being processed
            if (processingTasks.has(taskId)) {
                return;
            }
            
            // Mark task as processing
            processingTasks.add(taskId);
            
            // ✅ IMMEDIATELY UPDATE UI - Optimistic update
            const task = allTasks.find(t => t.id === taskId);
            let rewardAmount = 0;
            if (task) {
                rewardAmount = task.reward_amount;
                task.completed_today = (task.completed_today || 0) + 1;
                renderTasks(allTasks);
                
                // Update stats instantly
                const todayTasks = document.getElementById('todayTasks');
                const current = parseInt(todayTasks.textContent.split('/')[0]) || 0;
                todayTasks.textContent = (current + 1) + '/' + dailyLimit;
            }
            
            try {
                const token = localStorage.getItem('auth_token');
                if (!token) {
                    showResultModal(false, 'Login Required', '❌ Please login first to claim rewards.');
                    return;
                }
                
                const response = await fetch('/api/tasks/claim.php', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ task_id: taskId })
                });
                
                if (!response.ok) {
                    throw new Error('Server error: ' + response.status);
                }
                
                const data = await response.json();
                console.log('Task claim response:', data);
                
                if (data.success) {
                    // Update balance
                    if (data.new_balance !== undefined) {
                        updateNavBalance(data.new_balance);
                        // Update today's earnings
                        const todayEarnings = document.getElementById('todayEarnings');
                        const currentEarnings = parseInt(todayEarnings.textContent.replace('₹', '')) || 0;
                        todayEarnings.textContent = '₹' + (currentEarnings + data.reward);
                    }
                    
                    // ✅ SHOW SUCCESS MODAL (NO TOAST)
                    showResultModal(
                        true, 
                        '🎉 Task Completed!', 
                        'Great job! You earned the reward.',
                        data.reward || rewardAmount
                    );
                    
                    // Refresh tasks from server
                    await loadTasks();
                    await loadStats();
                    
                } else {
                    // ❌ If failed, revert the optimistic update
                    if (task) {
                        task.completed_today = (task.completed_today || 0) - 1;
                        renderTasks(allTasks);
                    }
                    // ✅ SHOW ERROR MODAL (NO TOAST)
                    showResultModal(false, 'Task Failed', '❌ ' + (data.message || 'Failed to claim task'));
                }
                
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Claim error:', error);
                
                // Revert optimistic update on error
                if (task) {
                    task.completed_today = (task.completed_today || 0) - 1;
                    renderTasks(allTasks);
                }
                showResultModal(false, 'Error', '❌ ' + error.message);
                
            } finally {
                // Always remove from processing set
                processingTasks.delete(taskId);
                isTaskInProgress = false;
                isTaskCompleted = false;
                currentTaskId = null;
            }
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ UPDATE NAV BALANCE
        // ============================================
        
        function updateNavBalance(amount) {
            document.querySelectorAll('#walletBalance, .wallet-balance, .balance-display').forEach(el => {
                el.textContent = '₹' + Math.round(amount);
            });
            
            const iframe = document.getElementById('navIframe');
            if (iframe && iframe.contentWindow) {
                try {
                    iframe.contentWindow.postMessage({
                        type: 'updateBalance',
                        balance: amount
                    }, '*');
                } catch(e) {
                    console.log('Cannot send to iframe:', e);
                }
            }
            
            localStorage.setItem('user_balance', amount);
            
            if (typeof ppUpdateBalance === 'function') {
                ppUpdateBalance(amount);
            }
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ RESET TASK STATE
        // ============================================
        
        function resetTaskStates() {
            processingTasks.clear();
            isTaskInProgress = false;
            isTaskCompleted = false;
            currentTaskId = null;
            if (timerInterval) {
                clearInterval(timerInterval);
                timerInterval = null;
            }
            timerOverlay.classList.remove('show');
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ TOAST FUNCTION (Only for non-task messages)
        // ============================================
        
        function showToast(message, type = 'info') {
            const container = document.querySelector('.toast-container');
            if (!container) {
                const newContainer = document.createElement('div');
                newContainer.className = 'toast-container position-fixed top-0 end-0 p-3';
                document.body.appendChild(newContainer);
            }
            
            const colors = {
                success: 'bg-success',
                error: 'bg-danger',
                warning: 'bg-warning',
                info: 'bg-info'
            };
            
            const toast = document.createElement('div');
            toast.className = `toast align-items-center text-white ${colors[type]} border-0`;
            toast.setAttribute('role', 'alert');
            toast.innerHTML = `
                <div class="d-flex">
                    <div class="toast-body">${message}</div>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-close btn-close-white me-2 m-auto" data-bs-dismiss="toast"></button>
                </div>
            `;
            
            const container2 = document.querySelector('.toast-container');
            container2.appendChild(toast);
            const bsToast = new bootstrap.Toast(toast, { delay: 3000 });
            bsToast.show();
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ LOAD ON PAGE LOAD
        // ============================================
        
        resetTaskStates();
        loadTasks();
        loadStats();
        
        setInterval(() => {
            if (!isTaskInProgress && !processingTasks.size) {
                loadTasks();
                loadStats();
            }
        }, 30000);
        
        console.log('✅ Earn page loaded successfully');
    </script>

</body>
</html>
```

    <script>
        // ============================================
        // AUTH CHECK
        // ============================================
        

        // ============================================
        // TOGGLE FAQ
        // ============================================
        
        function toggleFaq(element) {
            const answer = element.querySelector('.answer');
            const icon = element.querySelector('.toggle-icon');
            
            if (answer) {
                answer.classList.toggle('show');
                if (icon) {
                    icon.classList.toggle('rotated');
                }
            }
        }

        // ============================================
        // SMOOTH SCROLL FOR QUICK LINKS
        // ============================================
        
        document.querySelectorAll('.quick-links .btn').forEach(link => {
            link.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                const targetId = this.getAttribute('href');
                if (targetId) {
                    const target = document.querySelector(targetId);
                    if (target) {
                        const topOffset = 80;
                        const targetPosition = target.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset - topOffset;
                        window.scrollTo({
                            top: targetPosition,
                            behavior: 'smooth'
                        });
                    }
                }
            });
        });

        // ============================================
        // TOAST NOTIFICATIONS
        // ============================================
        
        function showToast(message, type = 'info') {
            document.querySelectorAll('.toast').forEach(t => t.remove());
            
            const colors = {
                success: 'bg-success',
                error: 'bg-danger',
                warning: 'bg-warning',
                info: 'bg-info'
            };
            
            const toast = document.createElement('div');
            toast.className = `toast align-items-center text-white ${colors[type]} border-0`;
            toast.setAttribute('role', 'alert');
            toast.innerHTML = `
                <div class="d-flex">
                    <div class="toast-body">${message}</div>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-close btn-close-white me-2 m-auto" data-bs-dismiss="toast"></button>
                </div>
            `;
            
            let container = document.querySelector('.toast-container');
            if (!container) {
                container = document.createElement('div');
                container.className = 'toast-container';
                document.body.appendChild(container);
            }
            
            container.appendChild(toast);
            const bsToast = new bootstrap.Toast(toast, { delay: 3000 });
            bsToast.show();
        }

        // ============================================
        // DYNAMIC VALUES FROM ADMIN SETTINGS
        // ============================================
        // Uses the EXISTING /api/user/dashboard.php endpoint — no backend
        // changes required. That endpoint already returns a `settings`
        // object (min_withdrawal, max_withdrawal, required_tasks,
        // required_referrals, currency_symbol) alongside the dashboard
        // data, so we reuse it here instead of adding a new endpoint.
        // Same auth pattern as your other pages (profile.html etc.):
        // Bearer token read from localStorage's 'auth_token'.
        //
        // Note: referral bonus amount and support email aren't part of
        // that endpoint's response, so those two stay as static text
        // above — there's no existing API to pull them from without
        // changing a backend file.
        //
        // If the fetch fails (no token, logged out, offline, etc.) the
        // static defaults already in the HTML stay exactly as they are —
        // this only enhances the page, never blocks it.

        function formatAmount(value) {
            const num = parseFloat(value);
            if (isNaN(num)) return value;
            const rounded = Math.round(num * 100) / 100;
            return rounded.toLocaleString('en-IN', {
                minimumFractionDigits: (rounded % 1 === 0) ? 0 : 2,
                maximumFractionDigits: 2
            });
        }

        function setAllById(ids, text) {
            ids.forEach(id => {
                const el = document.getElementById(id);
                if (el) el.textContent = text;
            });
        }

        async function loadDynamicSettings() {
            const token = localStorage.getItem('auth_token');
            if (!token) return; // not logged in — keep static defaults

            try {
                const response = await fetch('/api/user/dashboard.php', {
                    headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token }
                });
                const json = await response.json();
                if (!json.success || !json.data || !json.data.settings) return;
                const s = json.data.settings;

                if (s.currency_symbol) {
                    document.querySelectorAll('.dyn-currency').forEach(el => {
                        el.textContent = s.currency_symbol;
                    });
                }

                if (s.min_withdrawal !== undefined) {
                    setAllById(
                        ['valMinWithdrawal1', 'valMinWithdrawal2', 'valMinWithdrawal3', 'valMinWithdrawal4', 'valMinWithdrawal5'],
                        formatAmount(s.min_withdrawal)
                    );
                }

                if (s.max_withdrawal !== undefined) {
                    setAllById(['valMaxWithdrawal1', 'valMaxWithdrawal2'], formatAmount(s.max_withdrawal));
                }

                if (s.required_tasks !== undefined) {
                    setAllById(['valRequiredTasks'], s.required_tasks);
                }

                // required_referrals has no on/off toggle in the current API,
                // so the rule is always shown (matches actual current
                // withdrawal behavior) — just fill in the real number,
                // falling back to the page's existing default if the
                // settings table has no row for it yet.
                setAllById(['valRequiredReferrals'], s.required_referrals || '5');
            } catch (err) {
                console.warn('Could not load dynamic settings, showing defaults:', err);
            }
        }

        loadDynamicSettings();

        console.log('✅ Help & Support page loaded');
    </script>

</body>
</html>

## `public_html/helpers/functions.php`

```php
<?php
// backend/helpers/functions.php

function generateReferralCode($length = 8) {
    $characters = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789';
    $code = '';
    for ($i = 0; $i < $length; $i++) {
        $code .= $characters[rand(0, strlen($characters) - 1)];
    }
    return $code;
}


function formatCurrency($amount) {
    $amount = floatval($amount);
    return '₹' . number_format($amount, 2);
}

function getClientIP() {
    $ip = $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? '0.0.0.0';
    
    if (isset($_SERVER['HTTP_CLIENT_IP'])) {
        $ip = $_SERVER['HTTP_CLIENT_IP'];
    } elseif (isset($_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR'])) {
        $ip = $_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR'];
    }
    
    return $ip;
}

function getDeviceFingerprint() {
    $data = [
        $_SERVER['HTTP_USER_AGENT'] ?? '',
        $_SERVER['HTTP_ACCEPT_LANGUAGE'] ?? '',
        $_SERVER['HTTP_SEC_CH_UA_PLATFORM'] ?? ''
    ];
    
    return md5(implode('||', $data));
}

function logActivity($userId, $action, $details = null) {
    $db = Database::getInstance();
    $conn = $db->getConnection();
    
    $stmt = $conn->prepare("
        INSERT INTO activity_logs (user_id, action, details, ip_address, user_agent, created_at) 
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NOW())
    ");
    $stmt->execute([
        $userId,
        $action,
        $details ? json_encode($details) : null,
        getClientIP(),
        $_SERVER['HTTP_USER_AGENT'] ?? 'unknown'
    ]);
}

function getSetting($key, $default = null) {
    $db = Database::getInstance();
    $conn = $db->getConnection();
    
    $stmt = $conn->prepare("SELECT setting_value FROM settings WHERE setting_key = ?");
    $stmt->execute([$key]);
    $result = $stmt->fetch();
    
    return $result ? $result['setting_value'] : $default;
}

function updateSetting($key, $value) {
    $db = Database::getInstance();
    $conn = $db->getConnection();
    
    $stmt = $conn->prepare("
        UPDATE settings 
        SET setting_value = ?, updated_at = NOW() 
        WHERE setting_key = ?
    ");
    return $stmt->execute([$value, $key]);
}

function validatePhone($phone) {
    return preg_match('/^[0-9]{10,15}$/', $phone);
}

function validateReferralCode($code) {
    return preg_match('/^[A-Z0-9]{8}$/', $code);
}

function sendNotification($userId, $title, $message, $type = 'in_app') {
    $db = Database::getInstance();
    $conn = $db->getConnection();
    
    $stmt = $conn->prepare("
        INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, title, message, type, created_at) 
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, NOW())
    ");
    return $stmt->execute([$userId, $title, $message, $type]);
}

function checkFraud($userId) {
    $db = Database::getInstance();
    $conn = $db->getConnection();
    
    // Check for multiple accounts from same device
    $stmt = $conn->prepare("
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) as count
        FROM users u
        JOIN user_devices ud ON u.id = ud.user_id
        WHERE ud.device_id IN (
            SELECT device_id FROM user_devices WHERE user_id = ?
        )
    ");
    $stmt->execute([$userId]);
    $deviceAccounts = $stmt->fetch()['count'];
    
    if ($deviceAccounts > 3) {
        // Flag for fraud
        $stmt = $conn->prepare("
            INSERT INTO fraud_reports (user_id, fraud_type, description, status, created_at) 
            VALUES (?, 'multiple_accounts', ?, 'pending', NOW())
        ");
        $stmt->execute([
            $userId,
            "User has $deviceAccounts accounts from same device"
        ]);
        return true;
    }
    
    return false;
}

function getPaginationData($page, $perPage, $total) {
    $page = max(1, $page);
    $totalPages = ceil($total / $perPage);
    $offset = ($page - 1) * $perPage;
    
    return [
        'page' => $page,
        'per_page' => $perPage,
        'total' => $total,
        'total_pages' => $totalPages,
        'offset' => $offset
    ];
}

use PHPMailer\PHPMailer\PHPMailer;
use PHPMailer\PHPMailer\SMTP;
use PHPMailer\PHPMailer\Exception;

class Mailer {
    private $mail;
    
    public function __construct() {
        $this->mail = new PHPMailer(true);
        
        try {
            $this->mail->isSMTP();
            $this->mail->Host = defined('SMTP_HOST') ? SMTP_HOST : 'smtp.gmail.com';
            $this->mail->SMTPAuth = true;
            $this->mail->Username = defined('SMTP_USER') ? SMTP_USER : 'noreply.paisapay@gmail.com';
            $this->mail->Password = defined('SMTP_PASS') ? SMTP_PASS : 'avfitjicggmmolsc';
            $this->mail->SMTPSecure = PHPMailer::ENCRYPTION_STARTTLS;
            $this->mail->Port = defined('SMTP_PORT') ? SMTP_PORT : 587;
            $this->mail->setFrom(
                defined('SMTP_FROM') ? SMTP_FROM : 'noreply.paisapay@gmail.com',
                defined('SMTP_FROM_NAME') ? SMTP_FROM_NAME : 'PaisaPay'
            );
            $this->mail->isHTML(true);
            $this->mail->CharSet = 'UTF-8';
        } catch (Exception $e) {
            error_log('Mailer init error: ' . $e->getMessage());
        }
    }

## `public_html/helpers/sanitize.php`

```php
<?php
// backend/helpers/sanitize.php

function sanitizeString($input) {
    return htmlspecialchars(strip_tags(trim($input)), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
}

function sanitizeEmail($email) {
    return filter_var($email, FILTER_SANITIZE_EMAIL);
}

function sanitizePhone($phone) {
    return preg_replace('/[^0-9+]/', '', $phone);
}

function sanitizeUrl($url) {
    return filter_var($url, FILTER_SANITIZE_URL);
}

function sanitizeAmount($amount) {
    return floatval(preg_replace('/[^0-9.]/', '', $amount));
}

function sanitizeArray($array) {
    foreach ($array as $key => $value) {
        if (is_array($value)) {
            $array[$key] = sanitizeArray($value);
        } else {
            $array[$key] = sanitizeString($value);
        }
    }
    return $array;
}

function escapeJson($data) {
    return json_encode($data, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE | JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES);
}
```

## `public_html/helpers/validation.php`

```php
<?php
// backend/helpers/validation.php

function validateRequired($data, $fields) {
    foreach ($fields as $field) {
        if (empty($data[$field])) {
            return "Field '$field' is required";
        }
    }
    return null;
}

function validateEmail($email) {
    return filter_var($email, FILTER_VALIDATE_EMAIL) !== false;
}

function validatePhoneNumber($phone) {
    return preg_match('/^[0-9]{7,15}$/', $phone);
}

function validateAmount($amount) {
    return is_numeric($amount) && $amount > 0;
}

function validateUrl($url) {
    return filter_var($url, FILTER_VALIDATE_URL) !== false;
}

function validateString($str, $minLength = 1, $maxLength = 255) {
    $len = strlen($str);
    return $len >= $minLength && $len <= $maxLength;
}

function sanitizeInput($input) {
    if (is_array($input)) {
        return array_map('sanitizeInput', $input);
    }
    return htmlspecialchars(strip_tags(trim($input)), ENT_QUOTES, 'UTF-8');
}

        overflow: visible !important;
    }

    .pp-notif-btn {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        width: 36px;
        height: 36px;
        background: transparent;
        border: none;
        color: #94a3b8;
        cursor: pointer;
        border-radius: 50%;
        transition: all 0.2s ease;
        position: relative;
        font-size: 16px;
    }

    .pp-notif-btn:hover {
        background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
        color: #ffffff;
    }

    .pp-notif-badge {
        position: absolute;
        top: 2px;
        right: 2px;
        min-width: 16px;
        height: 16px;
        padding: 0 4px;
        background: #ef4444;
        border: 2px solid rgba(17, 24, 39, 0.96);
        border-radius: 10px;
        color: #ffffff;
        font-size: 10px;
        font-weight: 700;
        line-height: 12px;
        text-align: center;
        display: none;
    }

    .pp-notif-badge.show {
        display: block;
    }

    .pp-notif-panel {
        position: absolute;
        top: calc(100% + 8px);
        right: -10px;
        width: 320px;
        max-width: calc(100vw - 32px);
        background: rgba(17, 24, 39, 0.98);
        backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
        border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
        border-radius: 14px;
        box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
        z-index: 999999 !important;
        opacity: 0;
        visibility: hidden;
        transform: translateY(-10px) scale(0.96);
        transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
        pointer-events: none;
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    .pp-notif-panel.open {
        opacity: 1 !important;
        visibility: visible !important;
        transform: translateY(0) scale(1) !important;
        pointer-events: auto !important;
    }

    .pp-notif-header {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        padding: 12px 14px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    }

    .pp-notif-header span.title {
        font-weight: 600;
        font-size: 14px;
        color: #ffffff;
    }

    .pp-notif-mark-all {
        background: transparent;
        border: none;
        color: #8B5CF6;
        font-size: 12px;
        font-weight: 500;
        cursor: pointer;
        padding: 2px 4px;
    }

    .pp-notif-mark-all:hover {
        text-decoration: underline;
    }

    .pp-notif-list {
        max-height: 340px;
        overflow-y: auto;
    }

    .pp-notif-item {
        display: flex;
        gap: 10px;
        padding: 12px 14px;
        border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: background 0.15s ease;
    }

    .pp-notif-item:hover {
        background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04);
    }

    .pp-notif-item:last-child {
        border-bottom: none;
    }

    .pp-notif-dot {
        flex-shrink: 0;
        width: 8px;
        height: 8px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: #8B5CF6;
        margin-top: 6px;
    }

    .pp-notif-item.read .pp-notif-dot {
        background: transparent;
    }

    .pp-notif-body .pp-notif-title {
        font-size: 13px;
        font-weight: 600;
        color: #ffffff;
        margin-bottom: 2px;
    }

    .pp-notif-item.read .pp-notif-body .pp-notif-title {
        color: #94a3b8;
        font-weight: 500;
    }

    .pp-notif-body .pp-notif-message {
        font-size: 12px;
        color: #94a3b8;
        line-height: 1.5;
        margin-bottom: 4px;
        display: -webkit-box;
        -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
        -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
        overflow: hidden;
    }

    .pp-notif-body .pp-notif-time {
        font-size: 11px;
        color: #64748b;
    }

    .pp-notif-empty {
        padding: 32px 14px;
        text-align: center;
        color: #64748b;
        font-size: 13px;
    }

    .pp-notif-empty i {
        font-size: 24px;
        display: block;
        margin-bottom: 8px;
        opacity: 0.5;
    }
    
    /* ✅ Fix for mobile */
    @media (max-width: 480px) {
        .pp-top-nav {
            height: 50px;
            min-height: 50px;
            padding: 0 12px;
        }
        .pp-nav-logo {
            font-size: 16px;
        }
        .pp-nav-logo i {
            font-size: 18px;
        }
        .pp-profile-btn .pp-avatar {
            width: 28px;
            height: 28px;
            font-size: 12px;
        }
        .pp-profile-btn .pp-arrow {
            display: none;
        }
        .pp-dropdown {
            right: -10px;
            min-width: 200px;
        }
        .pp-notif-btn {
            width: 32px;
            height: 32px;
            font-size: 15px;
        }
        .pp-notif-panel {
            right: -60px;
            width: 300px;
        }
        .pp-dropdown .pp-dropdown-item {
            font-size: 12px;
            padding: 8px 12px;
        }
    }
</style>

<script>
    // ============================================
    // ✅ DROPDOWN TOGGLE
    // ============================================
    
    var toggleBtn = document.getElementById('ppProfileToggle');
    var dropdownMenu = document.getElementById('ppDropdownMenu');
    var notifToggleBtn = document.getElementById('ppNotifToggle');
    var notifPanel = document.getElementById('ppNotifPanel');
    
    if (toggleBtn) {
        toggleBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            
            // Opening the profile menu closes the notification panel, and vice
            // versa below — only one flyout open at a time.
            if (notifPanel) notifPanel.classList.remove('open');
            if (notifToggleBtn) notifToggleBtn.classList.remove('open');
            
            if (dropdownMenu) {
                dropdownMenu.classList.toggle('open');
                
                if (dropdownMenu.classList.contains('open')) {
                    window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'expandNav' }, '*');
                } else {
                    window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'collapseNav' }, '*');
                }
            }
            this.classList.toggle('open');
        });
    }
    
    if (notifToggleBtn) {
        notifToggleBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            
            if (dropdownMenu) dropdownMenu.classList.remove('open');
            if (toggleBtn) toggleBtn.classList.remove('open');
            
            if (notifPanel) {
                notifPanel.classList.toggle('open');
                
                if (notifPanel.classList.contains('open')) {
                    window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'expandNav' }, '*');
                    ppLoadNotifications(); // refresh the list every time it's opened
                } else {
                    window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'collapseNav' }, '*');
                }
            }
            this.classList.toggle('open');
        });
    }
    
    // Close dropdown on outside click
    document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        var container = document.getElementById('ppProfileDropdown');
        if (container && !container.contains(e.target)) {
            if (dropdownMenu) {
                dropdownMenu.classList.remove('open');
                window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'collapseNav' }, '*');
            }
            if (toggleBtn) toggleBtn.classList.remove('open');
        }
        
        var notifContainer = document.getElementById('ppNotifWrap');
        if (notifContainer && !notifContainer.contains(e.target)) {
            if (notifPanel) {
                notifPanel.classList.remove('open');
                window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'collapseNav' }, '*');
            }
            if (notifToggleBtn) notifToggleBtn.classList.remove('open');
        }
    });
    
    // Close on Escape
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Escape') {
            if (dropdownMenu) {
                dropdownMenu.classList.remove('open');
                window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'collapseNav' }, '*');
            }
            if (toggleBtn) toggleBtn.classList.remove('open');
            
            if (notifPanel) {
                notifPanel.classList.remove('open');
                window.parent.postMessage({ type: 'collapseNav' }, '*');
            }
            if (notifToggleBtn) notifToggleBtn.classList.remove('open');
        }
    });
    
    // ============================================
    // ✅ UPDATE NAV
    // ============================================
    
    function ppUpdateNav() {
        try {
            var userData = localStorage.getItem('user_data');
            if (userData) {
                var user = JSON.parse(userData);
                
                var avatar = document.getElementById('ppNavAvatar');
                if (avatar) {
                    avatar.textContent = (user.full_name || 'U')[0].toUpperCase();
                }
                
                var userName = document.getElementById('ppNavUserName');
                var userEmail = document.getElementById('ppNavUserEmail');
                if (userName) userName.textContent = user.full_name || 'User';
                if (userEmail) userEmail.textContent = user.email || 'user@email.com';
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('PP Nav error:', e);
        }
    }
    
    function ppLogout() {
        if (confirm('Are you sure you want to logout?')) {
            localStorage.removeItem('auth_token');
            localStorage.removeItem('user_data');
            window.top.location.href = '/login.html';
        }
    }
    
    // ============================================
    // ✅ NOTIFICATIONS
    // ============================================
    
    var ppNotifPollTimer = null;
    
    function ppTimeAgo(dateStr) {
        // Safari/iOS won't parse "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" reliably — normalize to ISO-ish first.
        var d = new Date(dateStr.replace(' ', 'T') + 'Z');
        if (isNaN(d.getTime())) d = new Date(dateStr);
        var seconds = Math.floor((Date.now() - d.getTime()) / 1000);
        if (seconds < 60) return 'Just now';
        var minutes = Math.floor(seconds / 60);
        if (minutes < 60) return minutes + 'm ago';
        var hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
        if (hours < 24) return hours + 'h ago';
        var days = Math.floor(hours / 24);
        if (days < 7) return days + 'd ago';
        return d.toLocaleDateString();
    }
    
    function ppEscapeHtml(str) {
        var div = document.createElement('div');
        div.textContent = str == null ? '' : String(str);
        return div.innerHTML;
    }
    
    function ppUpdateBadge(count) {
        var badge = document.getElementById('ppNotifBadge');
        if (!badge) return;
        if (count > 0) {
            badge.textContent = count > 99 ? '99+' : String(count);
            badge.classList.add('show');
        } else {
            badge.classList.remove('show');
        }
    }
    
    function ppRenderNotifications(notifications) {
        var list = document.getElementById('ppNotifList');
        if (!list) return;
        
        if (!notifications || notifications.length === 0) {
            list.innerHTML = '<div class="pp-notif-empty"><i class="fas fa-bell-slash"></i>No notifications yet</div>';
            return;
        }
        
        list.innerHTML = notifications.map(function(n) {
            var isRead = String(n.is_read) === '1';
            return '' +
                '<div class="pp-notif-item' + (isRead ? ' read' : '') + '" data-id="' + n.id + '">' +
                    '<div class="pp-notif-dot"></div>' +
                    '<div class="pp-notif-body">' +
                        '<div class="pp-notif-title">' + ppEscapeHtml(n.title) + '</div>' +
                        '<div class="pp-notif-message">' + ppEscapeHtml(n.message) + '</div>' +
                        '<div class="pp-notif-time">' + ppTimeAgo(n.created_at) + '</div>' +
                    '</div>' +
                '</div>';
        }).join('');
        
        list.querySelectorAll('.pp-notif-item').forEach(function(item) {
            item.addEventListener('click', function() {
                if (!item.classList.contains('read')) {
                    ppMarkNotificationRead(item.getAttribute('data-id'), item);
                }
            });
        });
    }
    
    function ppMarkNotificationRead(id, itemEl) {
        var token = localStorage.getItem('auth_token');
        if (!token) return;
        
        // Update immediately so it feels instant; the request just persists it.
        if (itemEl) itemEl.classList.add('read');
        var badge = document.getElementById('ppNotifBadge');
        if (badge) {
            var current = parseInt(badge.textContent, 10);
            if (!isNaN(current)) ppUpdateBadge(Math.max(0, current - 1));
        }
        
        fetch('/api/notifications/mark-read.php', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token,
                'Content-Type': 'application/json'
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({ id: id })
        }).catch(function(err) {
            console.warn('PP Notif mark-read error:', err);
        });
    }
    
    function ppMarkAllRead() {
        var token = localStorage.getItem('auth_token');
        if (!token) return;
        
        document.querySelectorAll('.pp-notif-item').forEach(function(item) {
            item.classList.add('read');
        });
        ppUpdateBadge(0);
        
        fetch('/api/notifications/mark-read.php', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token,
                'Content-Type': 'application/json'
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({ all: true })
        }).catch(function(err) {
            console.warn('PP Notif mark-all error:', err);
        });
    }
    
    function ppLoadNotifications() {
        var token = localStorage.getItem('auth_token');
        if (!token) return; // not logged in — nothing to show
        
        fetch('/api/notifications/list.php?limit=20', {
            headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token }
        })
            .then(function(res) { return res.json(); })
            .then(function(json) {
                if (!json.success || !json.data) return;
                ppUpdateBadge(json.data.unread_count || 0);
                ppRenderNotifications(json.data.notifications);
            })
            .catch(function(err) {
                console.warn('PP Notif load error:', err);
            });
    }
    
    var markAllBtn = document.getElementById('ppNotifMarkAll');
    if (markAllBtn) {
        markAllBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
            e.stopPropagation();
            ppMarkAllRead();
        });
    }
    
    window.ppUpdateNav = ppUpdateNav;
    window.ppLogout = ppLogout;
    window.ppLoadNotifications = ppLoadNotifications;
    
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        ppUpdateNav();
        ppLoadNotifications();
        
        // Poll for new notifications every 45s rather than opening a
        // persistent connection — simple and good enough for this use case.
        if (ppNotifPollTimer) clearInterval(ppNotifPollTimer);
        ppNotifPollTimer = setInterval(ppLoadNotifications, 45000);
    });
    
    console.log('✅ Nav loaded - No balance display');
</script>

        /* ============================================
   PHONE MOCKUP
============================================ */

.phone-frame {
    width: 320px;
    max-width: 100%;
    margin: 0 auto;
    background: #0a0e1a;
    border-radius: 40px;
    padding: 14px;
    box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6), inset 0 0 0 2px #2a2a4a;
    position: relative;
}

/* ============================================
   DYNAMIC ISLAND (iPhone style)
============================================ */

.phone-frame {
    position: relative;
}

.dynamic-island {
    position: absolute;
    top: 15px;  /* ← Changed from 30px to 12px */
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    width: 85px;
    height: 25px;
    background: #0a0e1a;
    border-radius: 20px;
    z-index: 20;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 0 16px;
    box-shadow: 
        0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.08),
        inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

/* Camera dot */
.dynamic-island .camera-dot {
    width: 10px;
    height: 10px;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, #1a1a3e, #0a0a2a);
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(30, 30, 80, 0.3);
    position: absolute;
    left: 32px;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
}

/* Sensor dot */
.dynamic-island .sensor-dot {
    width: 6px;
    height: 6px;
    background: radial-gradient(circle at 40% 40%, #2a2a5a, #0a0a2a);
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
    position: absolute;
    right: 32px;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
}

/* Glow effect on hover */
.phone-frame:hover .dynamic-island {
    box-shadow: 
        0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.15),
        inset 0 0 20px rgba(108,60,225,0.05);
}

/* Dynamic Island animation */
@keyframes pulse-island {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
    50% { opacity: 0.6; }
}
.dynamic-island .camera-dot {
    animation: pulse-island 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}

/* Status bar adjustment - move icons down */
.status-bar {
    padding-top: 36px !important;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 15;
}

/* Hide the old notch */
.phone-frame::before {
    display: none;
}

@media (min-width: 992px) {
    .dynamic-island {
        top: 20px;  /* ← Moved down on desktop */
    }
    
    .status-bar {
        padding-top: 52px !important;  /* ← Adjust for moved island */
    }
}

.phone-screen {

    border-radius: 28px;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    height: 620px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

/* Bottom Navigation */
.bottom-nav-app {

/* Hide scrollbar */

        // MOBILE MENU TOGGLE
        // ============================================
        
        document.getElementById('menuToggle').addEventListener('click', function() {
            document.getElementById('navLinks').classList.toggle('open');
        });

        // ============================================
        // CLOSE MENU ON LINK CLICK
        // ============================================
        
        document.querySelectorAll('#navLinks a').forEach(link => {
            link.addEventListener('click', () => {
                document.getElementById('navLinks').classList.remove('open');
            });
        });
        
        // Update phone time
function updatePhoneTime() {
    const now = new Date();
    let hours = now.getHours();
    let minutes = now.getMinutes().toString().padStart(2, '0');
    document.getElementById('phoneTime').textContent = hours + ':' + minutes;
}

updatePhoneTime();
setInterval(updatePhoneTime, 30000);

        // ============================================
        // SMOOTH SCROLL
        // ============================================
        
        document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(anchor => {
            anchor.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                const target = document.querySelector(this.getAttribute('href'));
                if (target) {
                    const topOffset = 80;
                    const targetPosition = target.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset - topOffset;
                    window.scrollTo({
                        top: targetPosition,
                        behavior: 'smooth'
                    });
                }
            });
        });

        // ============================================
        // SCROLL ANIMATION
        // ============================================
        
        const observerOptions = {
            threshold: 0.1,
            rootMargin: '0px 0px -50px 0px'
        };

        const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach(entry => {
                if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                    entry.target.style.opacity = '1';
                    entry.target.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
                }
            });
        }, observerOptions);

        document.querySelectorAll('.feature-card, .step, .testimonial-card').forEach(el => {
            el.style.opacity = '0';
            el.style.transform = 'translateY(30px)';
            el.style.transition = 'all 0.6s ease';
            observer.observe(el);
        });

        console.log('✅ PaisaPay landing page loaded');
    </script>
