```php
<?php
// /api/admin/dashboard.php - DEBUG VERSION

// Show all errors
error_reporting(E_ALL);
ini_set('display_errors', 1);

header('Content-Type: application/json');
header('Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *');
header('Access-Control-Allow-Methods: GET, OPTIONS');
header('Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Content-Type, Authorization');

if ($_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] == 'OPTIONS') { http_response_code(200); exit(); }

// Check if config files exist
$config_file = __DIR__ . '/../../config/config.php';
$database_file = __DIR__ . '/../../config/database.php';

if (!file_exists($config_file)) {
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'config.php not found at: ' . $config_file]);
    exit;
}

if (!file_exists($database_file)) {
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'database.php not found at: ' . $database_file]);
    exit;
}

// Include files
require_once $config_file;
require_once $database_file;

try {
    $db = Database::getInstance();
    $conn = $db->getConnection();
} catch(Exception $e) {
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Database error: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
    exit;
}

// Test simple query
try {
    $test = $conn->query("SELECT 1")->fetchColumn();
} catch(Exception $e) {
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Query failed: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
    exit;
}

// Get stats
try {
    $total_users = $conn->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users")->fetchColumn();
    $pending_withdrawals = $conn->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM withdrawals WHERE status='pending'")->fetchColumn();
    $total_referrals = $conn->query("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM referrals")->fetchColumn();
    $revenue = $conn->query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount),0) FROM wallet_transactions WHERE transaction_type IN ('referral','task','bonus')")->fetchColumn();
    $recent = $conn->query("SELECT action, full_name, created_at FROM activity_logs al JOIN users u ON al.user_id = u.id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10")->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
} catch(Exception $e) {
    echo json_encode(['success' => false, 'message' => 'Stats query failed: ' . $e->getMessage()]);
    exit;
}

echo json_encode([
    'success' => true,
    'data' => [
        'total_users' => (int)$total_users,
        'pending_withdrawals' => (int)$pending_withdrawals,
        'total_referrals' => (int)$total_referrals,
        'revenue' => (float)$revenue,
        'recent_activity' => $recent
    ]
]);
?>

## `public_html/config/nginx.conf`

```text
# config/nginx.conf

server {
    listen 80;
    server_name your-domain.com;
    return 301 https://$server_name$request_uri;
}

server {
    listen 443 ssl http2;
    server_name your-domain.com;
    
    # SSL Certificate
    ssl_certificate /etc/nginx/ssl/your-domain.crt;
    ssl_certificate_key /etc/nginx/ssl/your-domain.key;
    
    # Security Headers
    add_header X-Frame-Options "DENY" always;
    add_header X-XSS-Protection "1; mode=block" always;
    add_header X-Content-Type-Options "nosniff" always;
    add_header Referrer-Policy "strict-origin-when-cross-origin" always;
    
    # Gzip
    gzip on;
    gzip_vary on;
    gzip_min_length 1024;
    gzip_types text/plain text/css text/xml text/javascript application/javascript application/json;
    
    # Root directory
    root /var/www/frontend;
    index index.html;
    
    # Frontend routing
    location / {
        try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html;
    }
    
    # API
    location /api/ {
        alias /var/www/backend/api/;
        try_files $uri $uri/ /api/index.php?$args;
        
        location ~ \.php$ {
            fastcgi_pass unix:/var/run/php/php8.1-fpm.sock;
            fastcgi_index index.php;
            fastcgi_param SCRIPT_FILENAME $request_filename;
            include fastcgi_params;
        }
    }
    
    # Admin Panel
    location /admin/ {
        alias /var/www/admin/;
        try_files $uri $uri/ /admin/index.html;
        
        # Basic Auth for extra security
        auth_basic "Admin Area";
        auth_basic_user_file /etc/nginx/.htpasswd;
    }
    
    # Static assets
    location ~* \.(jpg|jpeg|png|gif|ico|css|js|svg|woff|woff2|ttf|eot)$ {
        expires 1y;
        add_header Cache-Control "public, immutable";
    }
    
    # Logs
    access_log /var/log/nginx/paisapay-access.log;
    error_log /var/log/nginx/paisapay-error.log;
}

## `public_html/cron/validate-referrals.php`

```php
<?php
// /cron/validate-referrals.php

require_once $_SERVER['DOCUMENT_ROOT'] . '/config/config.php';

try {
    $conn = new PDO("mysql:host=".DB_HOST.";dbname=".DB_NAME.";charset=utf8mb4", DB_USER, DB_PASS);
    $conn->setAttribute(PDO::ATTR_ERRMODE, PDO::ERRMODE_EXCEPTION);
    
    // Get all referrals pending validation
    $referralStmt = $conn->prepare("
        SELECT r.id, r.referrer_id, r.referred_user_id, r.reward_amount,
               u.full_name, u.email, u.is_verified as email_verified,
               u.last_activity_date, u.activity_score
        FROM referrals r
        JOIN users u ON r.referred_user_id = u.id
        WHERE r.validation_status IN ('pending', 'under_review')
    ");
    $referralStmt->execute();
    $referrals = $referralStmt->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
    
    foreach ($referrals as $referral) {
        // Get task count for referred user
        $activityStmt = $conn->prepare("
            SELECT COUNT(*) as task_count 
            FROM task_history 
            WHERE user_id = ? AND is_claimed = 1
        ");
        $activityStmt->execute([$referral['referred_user_id']]);
        $activity = $activityStmt->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
        $task_count = intval($activity['task_count']);
        
        // Criteria for verified referral:
        // 1. Email verified
        // 2. At least 3 tasks completed
        // 3. Active (logged in within 30 days)
        $email_verified = $referral['email_verified'] == 1;
        $tasks_completed = $task_count >= 3;
        $is_active = $referral['last_activity_date'] && 
                     strtotime($referral['last_activity_date']) > strtotime('-30 days');
        
        $validation_notes = [];
        $status = 'verified';
        
        if (!$email_verified) {
            $validation_notes[] = 'Email not verified';
            $status = 'pending';
        }
        
        if (!$tasks_completed) {
            $validation_notes[] = "Only {$task_count} tasks completed (need 3)";
            $status = 'pending';
        }
        
        if (!$is_active) {
            $validation_notes[] = 'No recent activity (30+ days)';
            if ($status == 'verified') {
                $status = 'pending';
            }
        }
        
        // Update referral record
        $updateStmt = $conn->prepare("
            UPDATE referrals 
            SET 
                referred_user_verified = ?,
                referred_user_active = ?,
                referred_user_tasks_completed = ?,
                is_genuine = ?,
                validation_status = ?,
                validation_notes = ?,
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE id = ?
        ");
        $updateStmt->execute([
            $email_verified ? 1 : 0,
            $is_active ? 1 : 0,
            $task_count,
            $status == 'verified' ? 1 : 0,
            $status,
            implode('; ', $validation_notes),
            $referral['id']
        ]);
        
        // Log the update
        error_log("Referral #{$referral['id']} - User: {$referral['full_name']} - Status: {$status} - Tasks: {$task_count}");
    }
    
    echo "✅ Referral validation completed\n";
    
} catch (PDOException $e) {
    echo "❌ Error: " . $e->getMessage() . "\n";
}
?>
```

```css
/* ============================================
   PAISAPAY - ULTIMATE MOBILE-FIRST UI
   Premium Dark Theme | Touch Optimized

:root {
    /* Colors */
    --primary: #6C3CE1;

    --primary-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #6C3CE1, #9B59B6);
    --primary-gradient-hover: linear-gradient(135deg, #7C4CE1, #AB69C6);
    
    /* Backgrounds */
    --bg-primary: #0a0e1a;
    --bg-secondary: #111827;
    --bg-card: #1a2234;
    --bg-input: #0d1524;

    --text-primary: #ffffff;

    --danger-bg: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15);
    --warning: #f59e0b;
    --warning-bg: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.15);
    --info: #3b82f6;
    --info-bg: rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.15);

    --shadow-lg: 0 8px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
    --shadow-glow: 0 0 40px rgba(108,60,225,0.15);
    
    /* Radius */

    --radius-md: 14px;

    --radius-xl: 24px;
    
    /* Sizes */
    --header-height: 56px;
    --bottom-nav-height: 60px;
}

/* ============================================
   RESET
   ============================================ */

* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
}

html {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

body {
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif;
    background: var(--bg-primary);
    color: var(--text-primary);
    padding-bottom: calc(var(--bottom-nav-height) + 16px);
    padding-top: calc(var(--header-height) + 12px);
    overflow-x: hidden;
    min-height: 100vh;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
    touch-action: manipulation;
}

/* ============================================
   SCROLLBAR
   ============================================ */

::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 3px; }
::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--bg-primary); }
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--primary); border-radius: 2px; }

/* ============================================
   HEADER / NAVBAR
   ============================================ */

.navbar {
    background: var(--bg-secondary) !important;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    padding: 8px 16px !important;
    height: var(--header-height);
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    position: fixed !important;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    right: 0;
    z-index: 1050;
}

}

.navbar-brand i {
    font-size: 20px;

}

.navbar .badge {
    font-size: 11px;

}

/* ============================================
   BOTTOM NAVIGATION
   ============================================ */

.navbar.fixed-bottom {
    background: var(--bg-secondary) !important;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    padding: 4px 0 env(safe-area-inset-bottom) !important;
    height: var(--bottom-nav-height);
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);

    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;

.navbar.fixed-bottom .container {

}

.nav-link {
    color: var(--text-muted) !important;

.form-label {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.input-group {
    display: flex;
    align-items: stretch;
}

.input-group .input-group-text {
    background: var(--bg-input);
    border: 2px solid var(--border-color);
    border-right: none;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    padding: 0 14px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm) 0 0 var(--radius-sm);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    min-height: 48px;
}

.input-group .form-control {
    border-radius: 0 var(--radius-sm) var(--radius-sm) 0;
}

.form-check {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    padding: 0;
}

.form-check-input {
    width: 20px;
    height: 20px;
    background: var(--bg-input);
    border: 2px solid var(--border-color);
    border-radius: 4px;
    cursor: pointer;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    margin: 0;
}

.form-check-input:checked {
    background: var(--primary);
    border-color: var(--primary);
}

.form-check-label {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    cursor: pointer;
}

/* ============================================
   BADGES
   ============================================ */

.badge {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 4px;
    padding: 4px 12px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 11px;
}

.badge-success { background: var(--success-bg); color: var(--success); }
.badge-danger { background: var(--danger-bg); color: var(--danger); }
.badge-warning { background: var(--warning-bg); color: var(--warning); }
.badge-info { background: var(--info-bg); color: var(--info); }
.badge-primary { background: rgba(108,60,225,0.15); color: var(--primary-light); }
.badge-secondary { background: var(--border-color); color: var(--text-secondary); }
.badge-gold { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F1C40F, #F39C12); color: #000; }

/* ============================================
   STAT CARDS
   ============================================ */

.stat-card {
    background: var(--bg-card);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    padding: 14px;
    text-align: center;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    min-height: 90px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.stat-card i {
    font-size: 24px;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.stat-card .number {
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: 800;
    line-height: 1.2;
}

.stat-card .label {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    font-weight: 500;
}

/* ============================================
   TASK CARDS
   ============================================ */

.task-card {
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    overflow: hidden;
    background: var(--bg-card);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    padding: 14px;
    text-align: center;
    min-height: 100px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.task-card:active {
    transform: scale(0.96);
}

.task-card .icon {
    width: 44px;
    height: 44px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 18px;
    color: white;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    background: var(--primary-gradient);
}

.task-card .title {
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1.3;
    display: -webkit-box;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.task-card .reward {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--warning);
    margin-top: 2px;
}

/* ============================================
   LIST ITEMS
   ============================================ */

.list-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 12px 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    gap: 10px;
    min-height: 56px;
}

.list-item:last-child {
    border-bottom: none;
}

.list-item .left {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
}

.list-item .left .avatar {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(108,60,225,0.15);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 14px;
    color: var(--primary-light);
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.list-item .left .info {
    flex: 1;
    min-width: 0;
}

.list-item .left .info .title {
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 500;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

.list-item .left .info .sub {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--text-muted);
}

.list-item .right {
    text-align: right;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.list-item .right .amount {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 700;
}

.list-item .right .amount.positive { color: var(--success); }
.list-item .right .amount.negative { color: var(--danger); }

.list-item .right .date {
    font-size: 10px;
    color: var(--text-muted);
    display: block;
}

/* ============================================
   LOGIN/SIGNUP CARD
   ============================================ */

.auth-card {
    background: var(--bg-card);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    padding: 28px 20px;
    max-width: 400px;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0 auto;
}

.auth-card .logo {
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
}

.auth-card .logo .icon {
    width: 64px;
    height: 64px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--primary-gradient);
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 28px;
    color: white;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(108,60,225,0.3);
    margin-bottom: 12px;
}

.auth-card .logo h2 {
    font-size: 22px;
    font-weight: 800;
}

.auth-card .logo p {
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    font-size: 14px;
    margin: 0;
}


/* ============================================
   ✅ UNIVERSAL FIX: Input Text Color
   Works on all pages, all form inputs
   ============================================ */

/* All input fields - Force dark background & white text */
input,
textarea,
select,
.form-control,
.form-select {
    background-color: #0d1524 !important;
    color: #ffffff !important;
    border: 2px solid #1e293b !important;
}

/* When focused/typing - Keep dark background */
input:focus,
textarea:focus,
select:focus,
.form-control:focus,
.form-select:focus {
    background-color: #0d1524 !important;
    color: #ffffff !important;
    border-color: #6C3CE1 !important;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(108, 60, 225, 0.15) !important;
    outline: none !important;
}

/* Placeholder text color */
input::placeholder,
textarea::placeholder,
.form-control::placeholder {
    color: #64748b !important;
    opacity: 1 !important;
}

/* Disabled inputs */
input:disabled,
textarea:disabled,
.form-control:disabled {
    opacity: 0.6 !important;
    cursor: not-allowed !important;
}

/* Number input arrows - keep dark */
input[type="number"] {
    -moz-appearance: textfield;
    appearance: textfield;
}
input[type="number"]::-webkit-inner-spin-button,
input[type="number"]::-webkit-outer-spin-button {
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    margin: 0;
}

/* Autofill override - prevent white background */
input:-webkit-autofill,
input:-webkit-autofill:hover,
input:-webkit-autofill:focus,
input:-webkit-autofill:active {
    -webkit-box-shadow: 0 0 0 1000px #0d1524 inset !important;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: #ffffff !important;
    transition: background-color 5000s ease-in-out 0s;
}

/* Select dropdown */
select option {
    background-color: #0d1524 !important;
    color: #ffffff !important;
}

/* Input group addon */
.input-group-text {
    background-color: #0d1524 !important;
    color: #94a3b8 !important;
    border: 2px solid #1e293b !important;
}
/* ============================================
   TOAST
   ============================================ */

.toast-container {
    z-index: 9999;
    padding: 12px;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.toast-container .toast {
    pointer-events: auto;
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    color: var(--text-primary);
    box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
    max-width: 100%;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.toast .toast-body {
    padding: 12px 16px;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 500;
}


/* ============================================
   ✅ FINAL TOAST FIX - BELOW NAV
   ============================================ */

/* Nav bar z-index */
.navbar-universal,
.pp-top-nav,
.top-nav,
#ppTopNav {
    z-index: 1000 !important;
}

/* Toast - BELOW nav but ABOVE content */
.custom-toast-fixed {
    z-index: 999 !important;
    position: fixed !important;
    top: 65px !important;
    left: 50% !important;
    transform: translateX(-50%) !important;
    background: #1a2234 !important;
    color: #ffffff !important;
    border: 1px solid #1e293b !important;
    border-radius: 12px !important;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5) !important;
    padding: 12px 24px !important;
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif !important;
    font-size: 14px !important;
    font-weight: 500 !important;
    min-width: 280px !important;
    max-width: 90% !important;
    text-align: center !important;
    display: flex !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    justify-content: center !important;
    gap: 16px !important;
    pointer-events: auto !important;
}

/* Override any other toast */
.toast-container,
.toast,
.pp-toast,
.custom-toast {
    z-index: 999 !important;
}

/* Mobile */
@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .custom-toast-fixed {
        top: 58px !important;
        min-width: auto !important;
        max-width: 95% !important;
        font-size: 13px !important;
        padding: 10px 16px !important;
        left: 10px !important;
        right: 10px !important;
        transform: none !important;
        width: auto !important;
    }
}

/* ============================================
   EMPTY STATE
   ============================================ */

.empty-state {
    text-align: center;
    padding: 40px 20px;
    color: var(--text-muted);
}

.empty-state i {
    font-size: 40px;
    opacity: 0.3;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.empty-state h6 {
    font-size: 15px;
    color: var(--text-secondary);
    margin: 0;
}

.empty-state p {
    font-size: 13px;
    margin: 0;
}

/* ============================================
   RESPONSIVE BREAKPOINTS
   ============================================ */

/* Mobile First - Default styles are for mobile */

/* Small phones (under 400px) */
@media (max-width: 400px) {
    .card-body { padding: 12px; }
    .btn { font-size: 13px; padding: 10px 14px; min-height: 42px; }
    .stat-card .number { font-size: 18px; }
    .nav-link i { font-size: 18px; }
    .nav-link span { font-size: 8px; }
    .auth-card { padding: 20px 14px; }
    .auth-card .logo .icon { width: 56px; height: 56px; font-size: 24px; }
    .auth-card .logo h2 { font-size: 20px; }
    .task-card { padding: 10px; min-height: 80px; }
    .task-card .icon { width: 36px; height: 36px; font-size: 16px; }
    .task-card .title { font-size: 11px; }
}

/* Tablets (768px and up) */
@media (min-width: 768px) {
    body { padding-top: calc(var(--header-height) + 20px); padding-bottom: calc(var(--bottom-nav-height) + 24px); }
    .card-body { padding: 24px; }
    .auth-card { padding: 40px 32px; }
    .stat-card .number { font-size: 28px; }
    .container { max-width: 720px; }
}

/* Desktops (992px and up) */
@media (min-width: 992px) {
    .container { max-width: 960px; }
}

/* Large Desktops (1200px and up) */
@media (min-width: 1200px) {
    .container { max-width: 1140px; }
}

/* ============================================
   ANIMATIONS
   ============================================ */

@keyframes fadeInUp {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

@keyframes slideUp {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(10px); }
    to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

.fade-in {
    animation: fadeInUp 0.4s ease-out;
}

.slide-up {
    animation: slideUp 0.3s ease-out;
}

/* ============================================
   UTILITY
   ============================================ */

.text-gradient {
    background: var(--primary-gradient);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
}

.text-secondary-custom { color: var(--text-secondary) !important; }
.text-muted-custom { color: var(--text-muted) !important; }
.bg-card-custom { background: var(--bg-card) !important; }
.border-custom { border-color: var(--border-color) !important; }

.gap-2 { gap: 8px; }
.gap-3 { gap: 12px; }
.gap-4 { gap: 16px; }

.fw-600 { font-weight: 600; }
.fw-700 { font-weight: 700; }
.fw-800 { font-weight: 800; }

.shadow-glow { box-shadow: var(--shadow-glow); }
.rounded-xl { border-radius: var(--radius-xl); }

/* ============================================
   GRADIENTS (Background classes)
   ============================================ */

.bg-primary-gradient { background: var(--primary-gradient) !important; }
.bg-gradient-purple { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6C3CE1, #8E44AD) !important; }
.bg-gradient-blue { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #3498DB, #2ECC71) !important; }
.bg-gradient-gold { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F1C40F, #F39C12) !important; }
.bg-gradient-green { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2ECC71, #27AE60) !important; }
.bg-gradient-red { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E74C3C, #C0392B) !important; }
.bg-gradient-pink { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #E91E63, #9C27B0) !important; }

/* ============================================
   HERO SECTION
   ============================================ */

.hero-section {
    min-height: 85vh;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 20px 0;
}

/* ============================================
   SCROLLBAR (Firefox)
   ============================================ */

* {
    scrollbar-width: thin;
    scrollbar-color: var(--primary) transparent;
}

/* ============================================
   SAFE AREA (Notch phones)
   ============================================ */

@supports (padding: max(0px)) {
    .navbar.fixed-bottom {
        padding-bottom: max(4px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) !important;
    }
}
```

<!-- ✅ NAV IFRAME -->
  
   <iframe

            iframe.style.background = 'transparent';
        }
    });
</script>

                </div>

            <div class="col-6 col-md-3">
                <div class="stat-card" onclick="window.location.href='invite.html'">
                    <div class="icon"><i class="fas fa-users text-success"></i></div>
                    <div class="number" id="referralCount">0</div>

            </div>
            <div class="col-6 col-md-3">
                <div class="stat-card" onclick="window.location.href='earn.html'">
                    <div class="icon"><i class="fas fa-tasks text-warning"></i></div>
                    <div class="number" id="taskCount">0</div>
                    <div class="label">Tasks Done</div>

            </div>
            <div class="col-6 col-md-3">
                <div class="stat-card" onclick="window.location.href='leaderboard.html'">
                    <div class="icon"><i class="fas fa-trophy text-info"></i></div>
                    <div class="number" id="userRank">#0</div>
                    <div class="label">Rank</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>

        <!-- Active Tasks -->
        <h5 class="text-white mb-3"><i class="fas fa-tasks me-2"></i>Active Tasks</h5>
        <div id="activeTasks" class="row g-2 g-md-3 mb-4">
            <!-- Loaded dynamically -->
        </div>

        <!-- Recent Activity -->
        <h5 class="text-white mb-3"><i class="fas fa-history me-2"></i>Recent Activity</h5>
        <div class="card bg-dark text-white border-secondary" id="recentActivity">
            <div class="card-body text-center text-secondary">No recent activity</div>
        </div>
                <!-- ✅ ADD THIS - See Full History Button -->
        <div class="text-center mt-3">
            <a href="activity.html" class="btn btn-outline-secondary btn-sm">
                <i class="fas fa-history me-2"></i>See Full History
            </a>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ============================================
    BOTTOM NAVIGATION - Fixed
    ============================================ -->
    
    <nav class="bottom-nav">
        <div class="container d-flex justify-content-around">
            <a href="dashboard.html" class="nav-link active" data-page="home">
                <i class="fas fa-home"></i>
                <span>Home</span>
            </a>
            <a href="earn.html" class="nav-link" data-page="earn">
                <i class="fas fa-tasks"></i>
                <span>Earn</span>
            </a>
            <a href="leaderboard.html" class="nav-link" data-page="leaderboard">
                <i class="fas fa-trophy"></i>
                <span>Rank</span>
            </a>
            <a href="invite.html" class="nav-link" data-page="invite">
                <i class="fas fa-user-plus"></i>
                <span>Invite</span>
            </a>
            <a href="withdraw.html" class="nav-link" data-page="withdraw">
                <i class="fas fa-money-bill-wave"></i>
                <span>Withdraw</span>
            </a>
        </div>
    </nav>

    <!-- Toast Container -->
    <div class="toast-container position-fixed top-0 end-0 p-3"></div>

    <!-- Bootstrap JS -->
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>

    <script>
        // ============================================
        // ✅ AUTH CHECK - NO LOOP
        // ============================================
        
        const token = localStorage.getItem('auth_token');
        const userData = localStorage.getItem('user_data');
        
        if (!token || !userData) {
            window.location.replace('/login.html');
        }
        
        console.log('✅ User authenticated, loading dashboard');
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ LOAD USER DATA
        // ============================================
        
        try {
            const user = JSON.parse(userData);
            document.getElementById('userName').textContent = user.full_name || 'User';
            document.getElementById('referralCode').textContent = user.referral_code || 'Loading...';
            const balance = user.wallet_balance || 0;
            document.getElementById('balance').textContent = '₹' + Math.round(balance);
            
            // ✅ Update top nav balance if available
            setTimeout(function() {
                if (typeof ppUpdateBalance === 'function') {
                    ppUpdateBalance(balance);
                }
            }, 500);
        } catch (e) {
            console.error('Error parsing user data:', e);
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ LOAD DASHBOARD DATA
        // ============================================
        
        async function loadDashboard() {
            try {
                const response = await fetch('https://paisa-pay.online/api/user/dashboard.php', {
                    headers: {
                        'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token
                    }
                });
                
                if (response.status === 401) {
                    localStorage.removeItem('auth_token');
                    localStorage.removeItem('user_data');
                    window.location.replace('/login.html');
                    return;
                }
                
                const data = await response.json();
                
                if (!data.success) {
                    showToast(data.message || 'Error loading dashboard', 'error');
                    return;
                }
                
                const d = data.data;
                
                // Update stats
                document.getElementById('referralCount').textContent = d.stats?.referrals?.total || 0;
                document.getElementById('taskCount').textContent = d.stats?.tasks?.total || 0;
                document.getElementById('userRank').textContent = '#0';
                
                // Update wallet balance
                if (d.user?.wallet_balance !== undefined) {
                    const balance = d.user.wallet_balance;
                    document.getElementById('balance').textContent = '₹' + Math.round(balance);
                    
                    // ✅ Update top nav balance
                    setTimeout(function() {
                        if (typeof ppUpdateBalance === 'function') {
                            ppUpdateBalance(balance);
                        }
                    }, 100);
                }
                
                // Render tasks
                renderTasks(d.active_tasks || []);
                
                // Render activity
                renderActivity(d.recent_transactions || []);
                
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Dashboard error:', error);
                showToast('Error loading dashboard', 'error');
            }
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ RENDER TASKS
        // ============================================
        
        function renderTasks(tasks) {
            const container = document.getElementById('activeTasks');
            
            if (!tasks || tasks.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="col-12">
                        <div class="card bg-dark text-white text-center py-4 border-secondary">
                            <i class="fas fa-inbox fa-2x text-secondary mb-2"></i>
                            <p class="text-secondary mb-0">No active tasks</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
                return;
            }
            
            const displayTasks = tasks.slice(0, 4);
            
            container.innerHTML = displayTasks.map(task => {
                const isCompleted = (task.completed_today || 0) >= (task.daily_limit || 1);
                const disabledClass = isCompleted ? 'disabled' : '';
                
                return `
                    <div class="col-6 col-md-3">
                        <div class="task-card ${disabledClass}" onclick="${isCompleted ? '' : `window.location.href='earn.html'`}">
                            ${isCompleted ? '<div class="disabled-overlay"><i class="fas fa-check-circle me-1"></i>Done</div>' : ''}
                            <div class="icon bg-primary-gradient">
                                <i class="fas ${task.icon || 'fa-link'}"></i>
                            </div>
                            <div class="task-title">${task.title}</div>
                            <div class="task-reward">₹${task.reward_amount}</div>
                            <div class="task-progress">
                                ${task.completed_today || 0}/${task.daily_limit || 1} today
                                ${isCompleted ? ' ✅' : ''}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }).join('');
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ RENDER ACTIVITY
        // ============================================
        
        function renderActivity(transactions) {
            const container = document.getElementById('recentActivity');
            
            if (!transactions || transactions.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = '<div class="card-body text-center text-secondary">No recent activity</div>';
                return;
            }
            
            container.innerHTML = transactions.slice(0, 5).map(tx => `
                <div class="list-item px-3">
                    <div>
                        <span class="badge ${tx.transaction_type === 'credit' || tx.transaction_type === 'task' || tx.transaction_type === 'referral' || tx.transaction_type === 'bonus' ? 'bg-success' : 'bg-danger'} me-2">
                            ${tx.transaction_type}
                        </span>
                        <span class="text-secondary small">${tx.description || tx.transaction_type}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="text-end">
                        <span class="${tx.transaction_type === 'credit' || tx.transaction_type === 'task' || tx.transaction_type === 'referral' || tx.transaction_type === 'bonus' ? 'text-success' : 'text-danger'}">
                            ${tx.transaction_type === 'credit' || tx.transaction_type === 'task' || tx.transaction_type === 'referral' || tx.transaction_type === 'bonus' ? '+' : '-'}₹${Math.round(tx.amount)}
                        </span>
                        <small class="text-secondary d-block">${new Date(tx.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</small>
                    </div>
                </div>
            `).join('');
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ COPY REFERRAL
        // ============================================
        
        window.copyReferral = function() {
            const code = document.getElementById('referralCode').textContent;
            if (code && code !== 'Loading...') {
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(code).then(() => {
                    showToast('Referral code copied!', 'success');
                }).catch(() => {
                    const input = document.createElement('input');
                    input.value = code;
                    document.body.appendChild(input);
                    input.select();
                    document.execCommand('copy');
                    document.body.removeChild(input);
                    showToast('Referral code copied!', 'success');
                });
            }
        };
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ TOAST
        // ============================================
        
        function showToast(message, type = 'info') {
            document.querySelectorAll('.toast').forEach(t => t.remove());
            
            const colors = {
                success: 'bg-success',
                error: 'bg-danger',
                warning: 'bg-warning',
                info: 'bg-info'
            };
            
            const toast = document.createElement('div');
            toast.className = `toast align-items-center text-white ${colors[type]} border-0`;
            toast.setAttribute('role', 'alert');
            toast.innerHTML = `
                <div class="d-flex">
                    <div class="toast-body">${message}</div>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-close btn-close-white me-2 m-auto" data-bs-dismiss="toast"></button>
                </div>
            `;
            
            let container = document.querySelector('.toast-container');
            if (!container) {
                container = document.createElement('div');
                container.className = 'toast-container position-fixed top-0 end-0 p-3';
                document.body.appendChild(container);
            }
            
            container.appendChild(toast);
            const bsToast = new bootstrap.Toast(toast, { delay: 3000 });
            bsToast.show();
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ LOAD ON PAGE LOAD
        // ============================================
        
        loadDashboard();
        
        // Refresh every 30 seconds
        setInterval(() => {
            loadDashboard();
        }, 30000);
        
        console.log('✅ Dashboard loaded successfully');
    </script>

</body>
</html>
```

            <div class="modal-content bg-dark text-white border-secondary">
                <div class="modal-header">
                    <h5 class="modal-title" id="taskModalTitle">Complete Task</h5>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-close btn-close-white" data-bs-dismiss="modal"></button>
                </div>
                <div class="modal-body" id="taskModalBody">
                    <!-- Dynamic content -->
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ============================================
    RESULT MODAL - UPDATED (No Toasts)
    ============================================ -->
    
    <div class="modal fade result-modal" id="resultModal" tabindex="-1" data-bs-backdrop="static" data-bs-keyboard="false">
        <div class="modal-dialog modal-dialog-centered">
            <div class="modal-content">
                <div class="modal-body text-center" id="resultModalBody">
                    <!-- Dynamic content -->
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ============================================
    BOTTOM NAVIGATION
    ============================================ -->
    
    <nav class="bottom-nav">
        <div class="container d-flex justify-content-around">
            <a href="dashboard.html" class="nav-link" data-page="home">
                <i class="fas fa-home"></i>
                <span>Home</span>
            </a>
            <a href="earn.html" class="nav-link active" data-page="earn">
                <i class="fas fa-tasks"></i>
                <span>Earn</span>
            </a>
            <a href="leaderboard.html" class="nav-link" data-page="leaderboard">
                <i class="fas fa-trophy"></i>
                <span>Rank</span>
            </a>
            <a href="invite.html" class="nav-link" data-page="invite">
                <i class="fas fa-user-plus"></i>
                <span>Invite</span>
            </a>
            <a href="withdraw.html" class="nav-link" data-page="withdraw">
                <i class="fas fa-money-bill-wave"></i>
                <span>Withdraw</span>
            </a>
        </div>
    </nav>

    <!-- Toast Container (Only for non-task messages) -->
    <div class="toast-container position-fixed top-0 end-0 p-3"></div>

    <!-- Bootstrap JS -->
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>

    <script>
        // ============================================
        // ✅ AUTH CHECK
        // ============================================
        
        const token = localStorage.getItem('auth_token');
        const userData = localStorage.getItem('user_data');
        
        if (!token || !userData) {
            window.location.replace('/login.html');
        }
        
        console.log('✅ User authenticated, loading earn page');
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ STATE
        // ============================================
        
        let allTasks = [];
        let currentFilter = 'all';
        let timerInterval = null;
        let timerSeconds = 0;
        let isTaskInProgress = false;
        let currentTaskId = null;
        let isTaskCompleted = false;
        let dailyLimit = 10;
        const processingTasks = new Set();
        let resultModal = null;
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ DOM REFS
        // ============================================
        
        const timerOverlay = document.getElementById('timerOverlay');
        const bigTimerDisplay = document.getElementById('bigTimerDisplay');
        const bigTimerProgress = document.getElementById('bigTimerProgress');
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ PAGE VISIBILITY API
        // ============================================
        
        document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function() {
            if (document.hidden) {
                console.log('⚠️ User left the page');
            } else {
                if (isTaskInProgress && !isTaskCompleted) {
                    console.log('⚠️ User returned early - task will fail');
                    clearInterval(timerInterval);
                    isTaskInProgress = false;
                    timerOverlay.classList.remove('show');
                    showResultModal(false, 'Task Failed', '❌ You returned to PaisaPay before the timer ended! Stay on the task page until the timer finishes.');
                }
            }
        });
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ BEFORE UNLOAD
        // ============================================
        
        window.addEventListener('beforeunload', function(e) {
            if (isTaskInProgress && !isTaskCompleted) {
                sessionStorage.setItem('task_interrupted', 'true');
                sessionStorage.setItem('interrupted_task_id', currentTaskId);
                sessionStorage.setItem('interrupted_time', Date.now());
            }
        });
        
        // Check interrupted task
        (function checkInterruptedTask() {
            if (sessionStorage.getItem('task_interrupted') === 'true') {
                const taskId = sessionStorage.getItem('interrupted_task_id');
                console.log('⚠️ Task was interrupted:', taskId);
                sessionStorage.removeItem('task_interrupted');
                sessionStorage.removeItem('interrupted_task_id');
                sessionStorage.removeItem('interrupted_time');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    showResultModal(false, 'Task Failed!', '❌ You left the page during the task. Please try again.');
                }, 500);
            }
        })();
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ LOAD DATA
        // ============================================
        
        async function loadTasks() {
            try {
                const response = await fetch('https://paisa-pay.online/api/tasks/list.php', {
                    headers: {
                        'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token
                    }
                });
                
                if (response.status === 401) {
                    localStorage.removeItem('auth_token');
                    localStorage.removeItem('user_data');
                    window.location.replace('/login.html');
                    return;
                }
                
                const data = await response.json();
                
                if (data.success) {
                    allTasks = data.data || [];
                    
                    if (data.today_stats) {
                        const todayTasks = document.getElementById('todayTasks');
                        if (todayTasks) {
                            const completed = data.today_stats.tasks_completed || 0;
                            todayTasks.textContent = completed + '/' + dailyLimit;
                        }
                        
                        const todayEarnings = document.getElementById('todayEarnings');
                        if (todayEarnings) {
                            todayEarnings.textContent = '₹' + Math.round(data.today_stats.earnings || 0);
                        }
                    }
                    
                    renderTasks(allTasks);
                } else {
                    showToast(data.message || 'Error loading tasks', 'error');
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Load tasks error:', error);
                showToast('Error loading tasks', 'error');
            }
        }
        
        async function loadStats() {
            try {
                const response = await fetch('https://paisa-pay.online/api/user/dashboard.php', {
                    headers: {
                        'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token
                    }
                });
                
                const data = await response.json();
                
                if (data.success) {
                    const d = data.data;
                    const wallet = d.user?.wallet_balance || 0;
                    document.getElementById('walletBalance').textContent = '₹' + Math.round(wallet);
                    
                    const todayEarnings = d.stats?.tasks?.today_earnings || 0;
                    document.getElementById('todayEarnings').textContent = '₹' + Math.round(todayEarnings);
                    
                    const todayTasks = d.stats?.tasks?.today || 0;
                    document.getElementById('todayTasks').textContent = todayTasks + '/' + dailyLimit;
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Load stats error:', error);
            }
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ RENDER TASKS
        // ============================================
        
        function renderTasks(tasks) {
            const container = document.getElementById('tasksContainer');
            
            const filteredTasks = currentFilter === 'all' 
                ? tasks 
                : tasks.filter(t => t.task_type === currentFilter);
            
            if (!filteredTasks || filteredTasks.length === 0) {
                container.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="col-12">
                        <div class="card bg-dark text-white text-center py-5 border-secondary">
                            <i class="fas fa-inbox fa-3x text-secondary mb-3"></i>
                            <p class="text-secondary">No tasks available</p>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
                return;
            }
            
            container.innerHTML = filteredTasks.map(task => {
                const limit = task.daily_limit || 1;
                const completedToday = task.completed_today || 0;
                const remaining = Math.max(0, limit - completedToday);
                const isCompleted = remaining <= 0;
                const disabledClass = isCompleted ? 'disabled' : '';
                
                let progressText = `${completedToday}/${limit} today`;
                if (isCompleted) {
                    progressText = `✅ ${completedToday}/${limit} - Done!`;
                } else if (remaining === 1) {
                    progressText = `${completedToday}/${limit} - ${remaining} left!`;
                } else {
                    progressText = `${completedToday}/${limit} - ${remaining} left`;
                }
                
                return `
                    <div class="col-6 col-md-4 col-lg-3">
                        <div class="task-card ${disabledClass}" data-task-id="${task.id}" onclick="${isCompleted ? '' : `openTask(${task.id})`}">
                            ${isCompleted ? '<div class="disabled-overlay"><i class="fas fa-check-circle me-2"></i>Done</div>' : ''}
                            ${isCompleted ? '<span class="completed-badge">✅ Done</span>' : ''}
                            <div class="icon bg-primary-gradient">
                                <i class="fas ${task.icon || 'fa-link'}"></i>
                            </div>
                            <div class="task-title">${task.title}</div>
                            <div class="task-reward">₹${task.reward_amount}</div>
                            <div class="task-timer"><i class="far fa-clock me-1"></i>${task.timer_seconds || 30}s</div>
                            <small class="text-secondary">${task.task_type}</small>
                            <div class="daily-limit-text">${progressText}</div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }).join('');
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ FILTER TASKS
        // ============================================
        
        window.filterTasks = function(filter) {
            currentFilter = filter;
            document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(btn => {
                btn.classList.toggle('active', btn.dataset.filter === filter);
            });
            renderTasks(allTasks);
        };
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ OPEN TASK
        // ============================================
        
        window.openTask = function(taskId) {
            if (isTaskInProgress) {
                showToast('⏳ Please wait for current task to complete', 'warning');
                return;
            }
            
            const task = allTasks.find(t => t.id === taskId);
            if (!task) {
                showToast('Task not found', 'error');
                return;
            }
            
            const limit = task.daily_limit || 1;
            const completedToday = task.completed_today || 0;
            const remaining = Math.max(0, limit - completedToday);
            
            if (remaining <= 0) {
                showToast(`✅ Task already completed ${limit}/${limit} times today!`, 'warning');
                return;
            }
            
            const modal = new bootstrap.Modal(document.getElementById('taskModal'));
            const body = document.getElementById('taskModalBody');
            
            body.innerHTML = `
                <div class="text-center mb-4">
                    <div class="icon bg-primary-gradient mx-auto mb-3" style="width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 12px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 24px; color: white;">
                        <i class="fas ${task.icon || 'fa-link'}"></i>
                    </div>
                    <h5>${task.title}</h5>
                    <p class="text-secondary small">${task.description || 'Complete this task to earn rewards'}</p>
                    <div class="alert alert-warning small mt-2">
                        <i class="fas fa-exclamation-triangle me-2"></i>
                        <strong>⚠️ Important!</strong> You will be redirected to the task page. 
                        <strong>Stay there until the timer completes.</strong> 
                        If you come back early, the task will fail!
                    </div>
                </div>
                
                <div class="modal-task-details">
                    <div class="detail-row">
                        <span class="text-secondary">Reward</span>
                        <span class="text-warning fw-bold">₹${task.reward_amount}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="detail-row">
                        <span class="text-secondary">Time Required</span>
                        <span>${task.timer_seconds || 30}s</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="detail-row">
                        <span class="text-secondary">Type</span>
                        <span>${task.task_type}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="detail-row">
                        <span class="text-secondary">Today's Progress</span>
                        <span>${completedToday}/${limit} (${remaining} left)</span>
                    </div>
                </div>
                
                <div class="mt-3">
                    <button class="btn btn-primary w-100" onclick="startTask(${task.id})" id="startTaskBtn">
                        <i class="fas fa-external-link-alt me-2"></i>Go to Task Page
                    </button>
                </div>
            `;
            
            modal.show();
        };
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ START TASK
        // ============================================
        
        window.startTask = function(taskId) {
            if (isTaskInProgress) return;
            
            const task = allTasks.find(t => t.id === taskId);
            if (!task) return;
            
            const limit = task.daily_limit || 1;
            const completedToday = task.completed_today || 0;
            
            if (completedToday >= limit) {
                showToast('✅ Task already completed today', 'warning');
                const modal = bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.getElementById('taskModal'));
                if (modal) modal.hide();
                return;
            }
            
            // Close task modal
            const modal = bootstrap.Modal.getInstance(document.getElementById('taskModal'));
            if (modal) modal.hide();
            
            // Set task state
            isTaskInProgress = true;
            isTaskCompleted = false;
            currentTaskId = taskId;
            const taskDuration = task.timer_seconds || 30;
            
            // Show timer overlay
            timerOverlay.classList.add('show');
            bigTimerDisplay.textContent = taskDuration;
            bigTimerProgress.style.width = '100%';
            
            // Open URL in new tab
            if (task.url) {
                window.open(task.url, '_blank');
            }
            
            // Start timer
            let remaining = taskDuration;
            
            if (timerInterval) clearInterval(timerInterval);
            
            timerInterval = setInterval(() => {
                remaining--;
                bigTimerDisplay.textContent = remaining;
                bigTimerProgress.style.width = `${(remaining / taskDuration) * 100}%`;
                
                if (!document.hidden) {
                    clearInterval(timerInterval);
                    isTaskInProgress = false;
                    timerOverlay.classList.remove('show');
                    showResultModal(false, 'Task Failed', '❌ You came back to PaisaPay before the timer ended! Stay on the task page until the timer finishes.');
                    return;
                }
                
                if (remaining <= 0) {
                    clearInterval(timerInterval);
                    isTaskCompleted = true;
                    timerOverlay.classList.remove('show');
                    claimTask(taskId);
                }
            }, 1000);
        };
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ SHOW RESULT MODAL - NO TOASTS
        // ============================================
        
        function showResultModal(success, title, message, reward = 0) {
            // Close any existing result modal
            if (resultModal) {
                resultModal.hide();
            }
            
            const modalElement = document.getElementById('resultModal');
            const body = document.getElementById('resultModalBody');
            
            const icon = success ? 'fa-check-circle' : 'fa-times-circle';
            const iconClass = success ? 'success' : 'failed';
            const btnClass = success ? '' : 'danger';
            const btnText = success ? 'Continue' : 'Try Again';
            const titleColor = success ? '#10b981' : '#ef4444';
            
            let rewardHtml = '';
            if (success && reward > 0) {
                rewardHtml = `
                    <div class="detail-box">
                        <div class="label">💰 You Earned</div>
                        <div class="reward-amount">₹${reward}</div>
                    </div>
                `;
            }
            
            body.innerHTML = `
                <div class="icon-big ${iconClass}">
                    <i class="fas ${icon}"></i>
                </div>
                <h3 style="color: ${titleColor};">${title}</h3>
                <div class="message">${message}</div>
                ${rewardHtml}
                <button class="btn-close-modal ${btnClass}" onclick="closeResultModal()">
                    ${btnText}
                </button>
            `;
            
            // Show modal
            resultModal = new bootstrap.Modal(modalElement, {
                backdrop: 'static',
                keyboard: false
            });
            resultModal.show();
        }
        
        function closeResultModal() {
            if (resultModal) {
                resultModal.hide();
                resultModal = null;
            }
            // Refresh data after closing
            loadTasks();
            loadStats();
            resetTaskStates();
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ TASK CLAIM - UPDATED
        // ============================================
        
        async function claimTask(taskId) {
            // Check if task is already being processed
            if (processingTasks.has(taskId)) {
                return;
            }
            
            // Mark task as processing
            processingTasks.add(taskId);
            
            // ✅ IMMEDIATELY UPDATE UI - Optimistic update
            const task = allTasks.find(t => t.id === taskId);
            let rewardAmount = 0;
            if (task) {
                rewardAmount = task.reward_amount;
                task.completed_today = (task.completed_today || 0) + 1;
                renderTasks(allTasks);
                
                // Update stats instantly
                const todayTasks = document.getElementById('todayTasks');
                const current = parseInt(todayTasks.textContent.split('/')[0]) || 0;
                todayTasks.textContent = (current + 1) + '/' + dailyLimit;
            }
            
            try {
                const token = localStorage.getItem('auth_token');
                if (!token) {
                    showResultModal(false, 'Login Required', '❌ Please login first to claim rewards.');
                    return;
                }
                
                const response = await fetch('/api/tasks/claim.php', {
                    method: 'POST',
                    headers: {
                        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                        'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify({ task_id: taskId })
                });
                
                if (!response.ok) {
                    throw new Error('Server error: ' + response.status);
                }
                
                const data = await response.json();
                console.log('Task claim response:', data);
                
                if (data.success) {
                    // Update balance
                    if (data.new_balance !== undefined) {
                        updateNavBalance(data.new_balance);
                        // Update today's earnings
                        const todayEarnings = document.getElementById('todayEarnings');
                        const currentEarnings = parseInt(todayEarnings.textContent.replace('₹', '')) || 0;
                        todayEarnings.textContent = '₹' + (currentEarnings + data.reward);
                    }
                    
                    // ✅ SHOW SUCCESS MODAL (NO TOAST)
                    showResultModal(
                        true, 
                        '🎉 Task Completed!', 
                        'Great job! You earned the reward.',
                        data.reward || rewardAmount
                    );
                    
                    // Refresh tasks from server
                    await loadTasks();
                    await loadStats();
                    
                } else {
                    // ❌ If failed, revert the optimistic update
                    if (task) {
                        task.completed_today = (task.completed_today || 0) - 1;
                        renderTasks(allTasks);
                    }
                    // ✅ SHOW ERROR MODAL (NO TOAST)
                    showResultModal(false, 'Task Failed', '❌ ' + (data.message || 'Failed to claim task'));
                }
                
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('Claim error:', error);
                
                // Revert optimistic update on error
                if (task) {
                    task.completed_today = (task.completed_today || 0) - 1;
                    renderTasks(allTasks);
                }
                showResultModal(false, 'Error', '❌ ' + error.message);
                
            } finally {
                // Always remove from processing set
                processingTasks.delete(taskId);
                isTaskInProgress = false;
                isTaskCompleted = false;
                currentTaskId = null;
            }
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ UPDATE NAV BALANCE
        // ============================================
        
        function updateNavBalance(amount) {
            document.querySelectorAll('#walletBalance, .wallet-balance, .balance-display').forEach(el => {
                el.textContent = '₹' + Math.round(amount);
            });
            
            const iframe = document.getElementById('navIframe');
            if (iframe && iframe.contentWindow) {
                try {
                    iframe.contentWindow.postMessage({
                        type: 'updateBalance',
                        balance: amount
                    }, '*');
                } catch(e) {
                    console.log('Cannot send to iframe:', e);
                }
            }
            
            localStorage.setItem('user_balance', amount);
            
            if (typeof ppUpdateBalance === 'function') {
                ppUpdateBalance(amount);
            }
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ RESET TASK STATE
        // ============================================
        
        function resetTaskStates() {
            processingTasks.clear();
            isTaskInProgress = false;
            isTaskCompleted = false;
            currentTaskId = null;
            if (timerInterval) {
                clearInterval(timerInterval);
                timerInterval = null;
            }
            timerOverlay.classList.remove('show');
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ TOAST FUNCTION (Only for non-task messages)
        // ============================================
        
        function showToast(message, type = 'info') {
            const container = document.querySelector('.toast-container');
            if (!container) {
                const newContainer = document.createElement('div');
                newContainer.className = 'toast-container position-fixed top-0 end-0 p-3';
                document.body.appendChild(newContainer);
            }
            
            const colors = {
                success: 'bg-success',
                error: 'bg-danger',
                warning: 'bg-warning',
                info: 'bg-info'
            };
            
            const toast = document.createElement('div');
            toast.className = `toast align-items-center text-white ${colors[type]} border-0`;
            toast.setAttribute('role', 'alert');
            toast.innerHTML = `
                <div class="d-flex">
                    <div class="toast-body">${message}</div>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-close btn-close-white me-2 m-auto" data-bs-dismiss="toast"></button>
                </div>
            `;
            
            const container2 = document.querySelector('.toast-container');
            container2.appendChild(toast);
            const bsToast = new bootstrap.Toast(toast, { delay: 3000 });
            bsToast.show();
        }
        
        // ============================================
        // ✅ LOAD ON PAGE LOAD
        // ============================================
        
        resetTaskStates();
        loadTasks();
        loadStats();
        
        setInterval(() => {
            if (!isTaskInProgress && !processingTasks.size) {
                loadTasks();
                loadStats();
            }
        }, 30000);
        
        console.log('✅ Earn page loaded successfully');
    </script>

</body>
</html>
```

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
    <title>Help & Support - PaisaPay</title>
    
    <link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css" rel="stylesheet">
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.5.1/css/all.min.css">
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&amp;display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    
    <style>
        body {
            padding-top: 56px !important;
            padding-bottom: 70px !important;
            background: #0a0e1a;
            font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
        }
        
        .section-card {
            background: #111827;
            border: 1px solid #1e293b;
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 24px 28px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        
        .section-card h4 {
            color: #ffffff;
            font-weight: 700;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }
        .section-card h4 .icon {
            margin-right: 12px;
        }
        .section-card h5 {
            color: #ffffff;
            font-weight: 600;
            margin-top: 20px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            font-size: 16px;
        }
        .section-card h5:first-of-type {
            margin-top: 0;
        }
        .section-card p {
            color: #94a3b8;
            font-size: 14px;
            line-height: 1.8;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }
        .section-card ul, .section-card ol {
            color: #94a3b8;
            font-size: 14px;
            line-height: 1.8;
            padding-left: 24px;
            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }
        .section-card ul li, .section-card ol li {
            margin-bottom: 6px;
        }
        .section-card ul li strong, .section-card ol li strong {
            color: #e2e8f0;
        }
        
        .highlight-box {
            background: rgba(108,60,225,0.08);
            border: 1px solid rgba(108,60,225,0.15);
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 16px 20px;
            margin: 16px 0;
        }
        .highlight-box p {
            margin-bottom: 0;
            color: #c4b5fd;
        }
        .highlight-box i {
            color: #8B5CF6;
            margin-right: 8px;
        }
        
        .faq-item {
            padding: 14px 0;
            border-bottom: 1px solid #1a2234;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        }
        .faq-item:last-child {
            border-bottom: none;
        }
        .faq-item:hover .question {
            color: #8B5CF6;
        }
        .faq-item .question {
            font-weight: 600;
            color: #ffffff;
            font-size: 15px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .faq-item .answer {
            font-size: 14px;
            color: #94a3b8;
            margin-top: 8px;
            display: none;
            line-height: 1.7;
        }

            var iframe = document.getElementById('navIframe');
            if (!iframe) return;
            if (event.data && event.data.type === 'expandNav') {
                iframe.style.height = '400px';
                iframe.style.background = 'transparent';
            } else if (event.data && event.data.type === 'collapseNav') {
                iframe.style.height = '56px';

Larger amounts may require additional verification.

    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js"></script>
    
    <script>
        // ============================================
        // AUTH CHECK
        // ============================================
        

        // ============================================
        // TOGGLE FAQ
        // ============================================
        
        function toggleFaq(element) {
            const answer = element.querySelector('.answer');
            const icon = element.querySelector('.toggle-icon');
            
            if (answer) {
                answer.classList.toggle('show');
                if (icon) {
                    icon.classList.toggle('rotated');
                }
            }
        }

        // ============================================
        // SMOOTH SCROLL FOR QUICK LINKS
        // ============================================
        
        document.querySelectorAll('.quick-links .btn').forEach(link => {
            link.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                const targetId = this.getAttribute('href');
                if (targetId) {
                    const target = document.querySelector(targetId);
                    if (target) {
                        const topOffset = 80;
                        const targetPosition = target.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset - topOffset;
                        window.scrollTo({
                            top: targetPosition,
                            behavior: 'smooth'
                        });
                    }
                }
            });
        });

        // ============================================
        // TOAST NOTIFICATIONS
        // ============================================
        
        function showToast(message, type = 'info') {
            document.querySelectorAll('.toast').forEach(t => t.remove());
            
            const colors = {
                success: 'bg-success',
                error: 'bg-danger',
                warning: 'bg-warning',
                info: 'bg-info'
            };
            
            const toast = document.createElement('div');
            toast.className = `toast align-items-center text-white ${colors[type]} border-0`;
            toast.setAttribute('role', 'alert');
            toast.innerHTML = `
                <div class="d-flex">
                    <div class="toast-body">${message}</div>
                    <button type="button" class="btn-close btn-close-white me-2 m-auto" data-bs-dismiss="toast"></button>
                </div>
            `;
            
            let container = document.querySelector('.toast-container');
            if (!container) {
                container = document.createElement('div');
                container.className = 'toast-container';
                document.body.appendChild(container);
            }
            
            container.appendChild(toast);
            const bsToast = new bootstrap.Toast(toast, { delay: 3000 });
            bsToast.show();
        }

        // ============================================
        // DYNAMIC VALUES FROM ADMIN SETTINGS
        // ============================================
        // Uses the EXISTING /api/user/dashboard.php endpoint — no backend
        // changes required. That endpoint already returns a `settings`
        // object (min_withdrawal, max_withdrawal, required_tasks,
        // required_referrals, currency_symbol) alongside the dashboard
        // data, so we reuse it here instead of adding a new endpoint.
        // Same auth pattern as your other pages (profile.html etc.):
        // Bearer token read from localStorage's 'auth_token'.
        //
        // Note: referral bonus amount and support email aren't part of
        // that endpoint's response, so those two stay as static text
        // above — there's no existing API to pull them from without
        // changing a backend file.
        //
        // If the fetch fails (no token, logged out, offline, etc.) the
        // static defaults already in the HTML stay exactly as they are —
        // this only enhances the page, never blocks it.

        function formatAmount(value) {
            const num = parseFloat(value);
            if (isNaN(num)) return value;
            const rounded = Math.round(num * 100) / 100;
            return rounded.toLocaleString('en-IN', {
                minimumFractionDigits: (rounded % 1 === 0) ? 0 : 2,
                maximumFractionDigits: 2
            });
        }

        function setAllById(ids, text) {
            ids.forEach(id => {
                const el = document.getElementById(id);
                if (el) el.textContent = text;
            });
        }

        async function loadDynamicSettings() {
            const token = localStorage.getItem('auth_token');
            if (!token) return; // not logged in — keep static defaults

            try {
                const response = await fetch('/api/user/dashboard.php', {
                    headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token }
                });
                const json = await response.json();
                if (!json.success || !json.data || !json.data.settings) return;
                const s = json.data.settings;

                if (s.currency_symbol) {
                    document.querySelectorAll('.dyn-currency').forEach(el => {
                        el.textContent = s.currency_symbol;
                    });
                }

                if (s.min_withdrawal !== undefined) {
                    setAllById(
                        ['valMinWithdrawal1', 'valMinWithdrawal2', 'valMinWithdrawal3', 'valMinWithdrawal4', 'valMinWithdrawal5'],
                        formatAmount(s.min_withdrawal)
                    );
                }

                if (s.max_withdrawal !== undefined) {
                    setAllById(['valMaxWithdrawal1', 'valMaxWithdrawal2'], formatAmount(s.max_withdrawal));
                }

                if (s.required_tasks !== undefined) {
                    setAllById(['valRequiredTasks'], s.required_tasks);
                }

                // required_referrals has no on/off toggle in the current API,
                // so the rule is always shown (matches actual current
                // withdrawal behavior) — just fill in the real number,
                // falling back to the page's existing default if the
                // settings table has no row for it yet.
                setAllById(['valRequiredReferrals'], s.required_referrals || '5');
            } catch (err) {
                console.warn('Could not load dynamic settings, showing defaults:', err);
            }
        }

        loadDynamicSettings();

        console.log('✅ Help & Support page loaded');
    </script>

</body>
</html>
